对，放行路径本身变慢或报错，说明问题可能出在限流组件自己不稳，而不是规则设置得不合理。
服务器名字长度跟限流规则是否合理、系统是否被攻击没有任何关系，不是有意义的监控维度。
optionExplanations_en: Right — breaking it down rule by rule is what actually helps; if one rule's pass rate suddenly drops, that pinpoints which one is set too tight.
Right — looking at who's getting blocked the most tells you whether the complaints are from real abuse ramping up or legitimate users getting caught.
Right — the allow path itself getting slower or erroring out points to the limiting component being unstable, not the rules being unreasonable.
Server name length has nothing to do with whether rate-limiting rules are reasonable or whether the system is under attack — not a meaningful monitoring dimension.

scenario: 客户端收到 429 后立即并发重试 10 次，导致限流器和 API 都更忙。
scenario_en: After receiving 429, a client immediately retries 10 times concurrently, making both the limiter and API busier.
q: 客户端应如何恢复？
q_en: How should the client recover?
options: 按 Retry-After 退避并加抖动
立刻开启无限循环重试
开更多线程去并发地重试同一个失败请求
忽略所有限流响应头
options_en: Back off using Retry-After and add jitter
Start an infinite retry loop immediately
Spin up more threads to retry the same failed request concurrently
Ignore all rate-limit response headers
why: 退避让客户端给系统恢复时间，抖动避免所有客户端同一秒回来。否则限流会被重试风暴放大。
why_en: Backoff with jitter gives the system time to recover and avoids synchronized retry storms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在重试等待时间上加入随机扰动，避免客户端同时重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Jitter adds randomness to retry delays so clients do not retry at the same time.

optionExplanations: 对，按 Retry-After 给出的时间等待、再加上一点随机抖动，能给系统留出恢复窗口，也避免所有客户端在同一秒一起涌回来，重新压垮限流器。
收到 429 立刻无限循环重试，只会让本来就超限的请求量变得更猛，进一步压垮限流器和 API。
增加线程并发重试同一个请求，等于用更高的并发去撞同一个已经被限流的配额，情况只会更糟。
忽略限流响应头意味着客户端完全不知道该等多久，很可能立刻发起下一轮无意义的重试。
optionExplanations_en: Right — waiting the time given by Retry-After, plus a bit of random jitter, gives the system room to recover and stops every client from surging back in the same instant and overwhelming the limiter again.
Retrying in an immediate infinite loop after a 429 only makes an already-over-limit request volume worse, further overwhelming both the limiter and the API.
Adding more threads to retry the same request in parallel just throws more concurrency at an already-rate-limited quota — it only makes things worse.
Ignoring the rate-limit headers leaves the client with no idea how long to wait, so it's likely to fire off another pointless retry right away.

q: 一个完整的限流中间件请求流程是什么？
q_en: What is a complete rate-limiter middleware request flow?
steps: 根据规则和 Redis 计数判断是否超限。
请求先进入限流中间件，而不是直接到业务 API。
未超限则更新计数并转发给 API 服务。
超限则返回 429，必要时把可延迟任务放入队列。
why: 限流器要先于业务服务做决策，放行路径和拒绝路径都要明确。拒绝并不总是丢弃，异步任务可以转入队列。
why_en: Middleware checks rules and counters before the API, then either forwards, rejects with 429, or queues delay-tolerant work.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client --> RL[Rate limiter]
RL --> Redis[(Counters)]
RL -->|allow| API[API]
RL -->|throttle| R429[429 or queue]

scenario: 你在做 20 台缓存服务器。缓存 key 用 hash(key) % N 找服务器，节点会自动扩缩容。你最担心哪类故障？
scenario_en: You run 20 cache servers and route keys with hash(key) % N while nodes can be added or removed automatically.
q: 取模分片在扩缩容时的问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main issue with modulo sharding during scaling?
options: 只有新增那个节点所负责的那一段 key 会移动
大多数 key 会重新映射，引发缓存未命中风暴
所有 key 会复制到每台服务器
hash 函数会变慢
options_en: Only the key range the new node takes over moves
Most keys remap and create a cache-miss storm
All keys are copied to every server
The hash function becomes slower
why: N 一变，几乎每个 key 的取模结果都可能变。缓存层会突然打到错误节点，然后把压力推回数据库。
why_en: When N changes, many modulo results change, so cache lookups miss at once and push load back to storage.
tradeoff: 实现简单 vs 扩缩容扰动
whenOtherWins: 如果节点集合长期固定，而且只是做小规模内存表，取模方案实现最省事。

termDefinitions.meaning: 大量缓存查询同时未命中，后端存储会被瞬间放大流量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache-miss storm is a burst of cache misses that suddenly shifts traffic to backend storage.

optionExplanations: 只有新增节点上的 key 会移动，这个说法只在节点数不变、只是内容调整时才成立，节点数一变，几乎所有 key 的取模结果都会跟着变。
对，N 一变化，绝大多数 key 的余数都会跟着改变，缓存层会集体打到错误节点，未命中会像潮水一样涌回数据库。
把所有 key 复制到每台服务器不是取模分片的行为，取模是把 key 分散、不是复制。
hash 函数本身的计算速度不会因为节点数量变化而变慢，瓶颈完全在于映射结果整体改变。
optionExplanations_en: Saying only the new node's keys move would only hold if the node count stayed fixed — the moment N changes, almost every key's modulo result changes too.
Right — when N changes, most keys' remainders shift, so the cache tier suddenly points at the wrong nodes and a flood of misses gets pushed back onto the database.
Copying every key to every server isn't what modulo sharding does — modulo spreads keys out, it doesn't replicate them.
The hash function's own compute speed doesn't slow down because the node count changed — the real problem is the mapping result changing wholesale.

scenario: 一个分布式缓存希望节点上下线时只搬一小段 key，而不是重算全量分片。
scenario_en: A distributed cache wants node joins and leaves to move only a small key range instead of reshuffling all keys.
q: 一致性哈希如何找 key 的归属节点？
q_en: How does consistent hashing locate the owner for a key?
options: 把 key 对服务器数量取模
把 key 和服务器都放到环上，顺时针找第一个服务器
随机挑一个健康服务器并写入副本
按各服务器实时的 CPU 使用率来动态挑选归属节点
options_en: Modulo the key by server count
Place keys and servers on a ring, then walk clockwise to the first server
Pick a random healthy server and write a replica
Choose a node dynamically by each server’s live CPU usage
why: 环上的顺时针后继把 key 绑定到相邻服务器。新增或删除节点时，只影响相邻区间，不会全局洗牌。
why_en: The clockwise successor on the ring owns the key, so membership changes only affect adjacent ranges instead of every key.
tradeoff: 局部迁移 vs 简单取模
whenOtherWins: 如果你需要按实时负载而不是稳定 key 归属调度请求，负载感知路由会更合适。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  K[key hash] --> R((hash ring))
  R --> S[first clockwise server]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把哈希空间首尾相接形成的逻辑环，用来统一放置 key 和节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash ring is a circular view of the hash space where both keys and nodes are placed.

optionExplanations: 把 key 对服务器数量取模是另一种分片方式，节点数一变就会大范围重映射，不是一致性哈希要的局部搬迁效果。
对，key 和服务器都哈希到同一个环上，沿顺时针找到的第一个服务器就是归属节点，节点增删只影响相邻的一小段。
随机挑一个健康服务器写副本，缺的是“同一个 key 下次还能找到同一个节点”这种确定性路由。
按 CPU 使用率动态选择服务器是负载感知调度，跟“key 稳定归属到哪个节点”是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Modulo-ing the key by server count is the other sharding scheme, and it triggers wide remapping the moment the node count changes — not the localized-move behavior consistency hashing is for.
Right — both keys and servers hash onto the same ring, and the first server found going clockwise owns the key, so adding or removing a node only touches one small neighboring stretch.
Randomly picking a healthy server to write a replica to lacks the deterministic property of "the same key always finds the same node next time."
Dynamically choosing a server by CPU usage is load-aware scheduling, a different concern from stably deciding which node a key belongs to.

q: 一致性哈希的查找规则怎么说？
q_en: How do you state the consistent-hashing lookup rule?
text: 一致性哈希会把 key 和节点映射到同一个哈希环；查 key 时从 key 位置开始{{顺时针}}走，遇到的{{第一个节点}}负责这个 key。
text_en: Consistent hashing maps keys and nodes to one ring; lookup walks {{clockwise}} from the key and uses the {{first node}} it meets.
why: 这句话是面试里的核心模型。后面的扩容、缩容、虚拟节点都在这个模型上讨论。
why_en: That lookup rule is the mental model behind scaling, removal, and virtual nodes.

scenario: 缓存环上已有 s0、s1、s2、s3，现在新增 s4，s4 落在 s3 和 s0 之间。
scenario_en: A cache ring has s0, s1, s2, and s3; a new s4 lands between s3 and s0.
q: 新增节点时应该搬哪段 key？
q_en: Which key range should move when a node is added?
options: 全环所有 key 都重分布
s3 到 s4 之间的 key 迁到 s4
s4 到 s0 之间的 key 迁到 s4
只移动访问量最大的 key
options_en: Redistribute every key on the ring
Move keys between s3 and s4 to s4
Move keys between s4 and s0 to s4
Move only the hottest keys
why: 新增节点只接管它逆时针方向到上一个节点之间的区间。其他 key 的顺时针后继没有变。
why_en: A new node takes over the range between the previous node and itself; other keys keep the same successor.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  S3[s3] --> K[affected keys]
  K --> S4[new s4]
  S4 --> S0[s0]

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点变更后需要迁移的哈希区间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The affected range is the part of the hash space that must move after membership changes.

optionExplanations: 全环所有 key 都重分布正是取模分片才有的问题，一致性哈希的意义就在于避免这种全局洗牌。
对，s4 落在 s3 和 s0 之间，它接管的正是逆时针方向到上一个节点 s3 之间的这段 key，其他区间的归属节点没有变化。
s4 到 s0 之间的 key 本来就属于 s0，s4 加入并不会动这段区间的归属。
只搬访问量最大的 key 不符合一致性哈希按环区间迁移的规则，它是按位置而不是按热度决定该搬哪段。
optionExplanations_en: Redistributing every key on the whole ring is exactly the modulo-sharding problem — the whole point of consistent hashing is avoiding that global shuffle.
Right — s4 sits between s3 and s0, so it takes over exactly the segment from s3 (its counter-clockwise neighbor) up to itself; every other segment's owner is unchanged.
Keys between s4 and s0 already belonged to s0 — s4 joining doesn't touch that segment's ownership.
Moving only the highest-traffic keys doesn't match how consistent hashing migrates by ring position, not by how hot a key is.

scenario: 缓存环上 s0、s1、s2 相邻。s1 下线后，原来落在 s0 到 s1 之间的 key 需要继续可读。
scenario_en: On a cache ring, s0, s1, and s2 are adjacent. s1 goes down, and keys between s0 and s1 must remain readable.
q: 删除节点时这些 key 去哪里？
q_en: Where do those keys go when the node is removed?
options: 迁到顺时针遇到的下一个节点 s2
平均散到所有节点
让这些 key 回到逆时针方向的前驱节点 s0
删除，等应用重新写
options_en: Move to the next clockwise node, s2
Spread evenly across all nodes
Move back to the counter-clockwise predecessor node s0
Delete them and wait for rewrites
why: s1 消失后，这段 key 的新顺时针后继是 s2。只迁这段能把下线影响压到局部。
why_en: After s1 disappears, s2 becomes the next clockwise owner for that range, so only that range moves.
optionExplanations: 对，s1 一下线，这段区间在环上顺时针遇到的第一个节点就变成了 s2，把这段 key 迁到 s2 正好把下线影响压缩在局部。
平均散到所有节点违背了环模型“只影响相邻节点”的设计初衷，会让下线的影响面不必要地扩大。
这段 key 顺时针的新后继是 s2，不是逆时针方向的 s0，往错误方向搬会导致路由和实际存储对不上。
直接删除这些 key 等应用重新写，等于主动制造一次数据丢失，不是一致性哈希该有的容错方式。
optionExplanations_en: Right — once s1 goes offline, the next node clockwise for that segment becomes s2, so moving those keys there keeps the impact of the outage localized.
Spreading them evenly across all nodes defeats the whole point of the ring model — that only neighboring nodes are affected — and needlessly widens the blast radius.
The new clockwise successor for that segment is s2, not the counter-clockwise s0 — moving them the wrong way leaves routing pointing somewhere the data isn't.
Just deleting those keys and waiting for the app to rewrite them is a self-inflicted data loss, not the kind of fault tolerance consistent hashing is supposed to provide.

scenario: 四台真实服务器只各放一个环位置。某两台离得很近，另一台占了很长一段哈希空间，读写明显不均。
scenario_en: Four physical servers each have one ring position; two are close together and another owns a huge range, causing uneven traffic.
q: 应该用什么机制平衡分区大小？
q_en: What mechanism helps balance partition sizes?
options: 给每台机器放多个虚拟节点
把所有 key 都复制三份
让客户端随机重试
把哈希函数改成自增 ID
options_en: Place many virtual nodes for each machine
Replicate every key three times
Let clients retry randomly
Change the hash function to auto-incrementing IDs
why: 虚拟节点让一台物理机拥有环上的多个小区间。样本点越多，单台机器吃到超大区间的概率越低。
why_en: Virtual nodes give each physical server many smaller ranges, reducing the chance that one server owns a huge slice.
tradeoff: 负载均衡 vs 环元数据
whenOtherWins: 如果集群很小、节点规格相同、扩缩容很少，一个物理节点一个位置也许够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实服务器在哈希环上的一个逻辑位置；一台服务器通常对应多个虚拟节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtual node is one logical ring position owned by a physical server.

optionExplanations: 给每台机器多放几个环上的位置，单台机器分到超大区间的概率就会明显下降，代价是要维护更多环元数据。
把所有 key 复制三份解决的是容错和读扩展问题，跟“环区间大小不均”完全是两个话题。
让客户端随机重试只是绕过了问题表现，请求最终还是会打到那台本来就过载的机器上。
把哈希函数换成自增 ID 会让 key 在环上按顺序排列，反而更容易扎堆，不会让分布更均匀。
optionExplanations_en: Giving each machine several positions on the ring noticeably lowers the odds any one machine draws an oversized span — the cost is more ring metadata to maintain.
Replicating every key three times addresses fault tolerance and read scaling, a completely different topic from uneven ring segment sizes.
Having clients retry randomly just papers over the symptom — the request still ends up hitting the same already-overloaded machine eventually.
Switching to a sequential auto-increment hash makes keys land on the ring in order, which clusters them further rather than spreading them out.

scenario: 你在调一致性哈希环的虚拟节点数量。更多虚拟节点能降低单机分区大小的方差，但每个虚拟节点都要存路由元数据。
scenario_en: You are tuning virtual-node count. More virtual nodes reduce ownership variance, but each virtual node adds routing metadata.
q: 虚拟节点数量的设计含义是什么？
q_en: What is the design implication of virtual-node count?
options: 越多越好，没有代价
需要在更平衡的负载和更多元数据之间取舍
它只能被设置成物理服务器台数的一半
只影响写入，不影响读取
options_en: More is always better and has no cost
Trade smoother load against more metadata
It must be half the physical server count
It only affects writes, not reads
why: 虚拟节点数越多，随机分布的标准差通常越小，热点机器更少。但路由表、心跳、迁移计划都会跟着变大。
why_en: More virtual nodes usually lower ownership variance, but they also enlarge routing metadata and operational work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标准差衡量数据围绕平均值的分散程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Standard deviation measures how spread out values are around the mean.

optionExplanations: 更多虚拟节点确实能降低分布方差，但路由表、心跳和迁移计划都会跟着变大，说“没有代价”忽略了这部分开销。
对，虚拟节点数量本质是负载均衡程度和元数据规模之间的一个可调旋钮，往哪边调都有对应代价。
虚拟节点数量是根据负载均衡需求和元数据成本权衡出来的，不是简单地固定成物理服务器数的一半。
虚拟节点决定的是 key 到物理机的映射，这个映射同时被读和写路径使用，不会只影响写入。
optionExplanations_en: More virtual nodes does lower distribution variance, but routing tables, heartbeats, and migration plans all grow along with it — calling it "no cost" ignores that overhead.
Right — the virtual-node count is essentially a dial between how balanced the load gets and how much metadata that costs, and either direction has a tradeoff.
The right virtual-node count comes from weighing balance needs against metadata cost, not from a fixed rule like half the physical server count.
Virtual nodes decide the key-to-machine mapping, which both reads and writes rely on — it doesn't affect writes only.

q: 一致性哈希主要解决哪些分片问题？
q_en: Which sharding problems does consistent hashing mainly address?
options: 节点增删时减少 key 迁移
让所有热点 key 自动变冷
支持水平扩展时保持较均匀分布
完全消除跨机房延迟
options_en: Reduce key movement when nodes join or leave
Automatically cool down every hot key
Keep distribution reasonably even during horizontal scaling
Eliminate cross-region latency entirely
why: 一致性哈希解决的是 key 到节点的稳定映射和较均匀分布。它能缓解热点分片，但一个超级热 key 仍需要缓存副本、拆 key 或限流。
why_en: Consistent hashing stabilizes key ownership and distribution, but a single hot key still needs separate mitigation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 访问量远高于普通 key 的数据项，可能压垮单个分片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot key is an item whose traffic is much higher than normal and can overload one shard.

optionExplanations: 对，节点增删时一致性哈希只搬相邻区间，这正是它相对取模分片的核心优势。
一致性哈希不会让热点 key 自动变冷，它只解决多个 key 之间的整体分布问题，单个超热 key 仍要单独处理。
对，把 key 和节点放到同一个环上正是为了在水平扩展时维持相对均匀的分布。
一致性哈希解决的是路由和分片问题，不涉及跨机房网络延迟，不能说它消除了延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Right — when nodes join or leave, consistent hashing only moves the neighboring segment, which is exactly its core advantage over modulo sharding.
Consistent hashing doesn't automatically cool down a hot key — it only balances the overall distribution across many keys; a single super-hot key still needs its own handling.
Right — putting keys and nodes on the same ring is precisely meant to keep distribution reasonably even as the cluster scales out.
Consistent hashing solves routing and sharding, not cross-datacenter network latency — it can't be credited with eliminating that.
scenario: 一个 200 节点的缓存集群每周都要扩缩容，运维要求每次变更只搬动一小部分 key。
scenario_en: A 200-node cache cluster resizes every week, and ops requires each change to move only a small slice of keys.

q: 为什么缓存扩容时一致性哈希比取模更稳？
q_en: Why is consistent hashing steadier than modulo hashing during cache scaling?
steps: 只迁移新节点和前驱之间的区间
节点数 N 改变会让 hash(key) % N 大面积变化
一致性哈希把 key 的归属变成环上后继关系
缓存未命中风暴会把流量推回数据库
why: 先指出取模的全局扰动，再给一致性哈希的局部迁移模型。这样面试官能听到问题和解法的因果链。
why_en: Explain the global disruption from modulo first, then the local movement property of consistent hashing.

scenario: 一个缓存服务会频繁自动扩缩容。你在比较取模分片和一致性哈希。
scenario_en: A cache service scales up and down frequently, and you are comparing modulo sharding with consistent hashing.
q: 两种分片的核心取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the core tradeoff between the two sharding methods?
options: 取模更容易实现；一致性哈希在成员变化时迁移更少
取模能跨机房复制；一致性哈希不能复制
取模天然防热点；一致性哈希只能单机运行
取模需要虚拟节点；一致性哈希不能用虚拟节点
options_en: Modulo is simpler; consistent hashing moves fewer keys on membership changes
Modulo replicates across data centers; consistent hashing cannot replicate
Modulo prevents hot keys; consistent hashing runs on one machine only
Modulo needs virtual nodes; consistent hashing cannot use them
why: 取模的接口很简单，但 N 变了就大范围重映射。一致性哈希多了环和虚拟节点元数据，换来扩缩容时少搬数据。
why_en: Modulo is simple but remaps broadly when N changes; consistent hashing adds ring metadata to move fewer keys.
tradeoff: 实现复杂度 vs 迁移范围
whenOtherWins: 固定服务器池、没有自动扩缩容时，取模分片的简单性可能更值钱。
optionExplanations: 对，取模的接口和实现都很简单，但成员一变就大范围重映射；一致性哈希多了环和虚拟节点的复杂度，换来的是成员变化时迁移范围小得多。
取模和一致性哈希都不天然处理跨机房复制，复制策略是在分片方案之上另外设计的，不是两者的区别所在。
两种方案都不天然防热点，热点 key 都要额外处理；一致性哈希也完全可以跨机器运行，不是只能单机。
恰恰相反，虚拟节点是一致性哈希的机制，取模分片不需要也用不上虚拟节点这个概念。
optionExplanations_en: Right — modulo's interface and implementation are simple, but membership changes trigger wide remapping; consistent hashing adds ring and virtual-node complexity in exchange for a much smaller migration footprint on membership changes.
Neither scheme natively handles cross-datacenter replication — replication is designed on top of the sharding scheme, not a distinguishing feature between the two.
Neither scheme is naturally hot-key-proof — both need extra handling for hot keys; and consistent hashing runs perfectly well across multiple machines, not just one.
It's the reverse — virtual nodes are a consistent-hashing mechanism; modulo sharding has no use for the concept at all.

scenario: 你的缓存集群混有 32 核大机器和 8 核小机器。你仍想用一致性哈希，但希望大机器承担更多 key。
scenario_en: Your cache cluster has large 32-core machines and smaller 8-core machines, and larger machines should own more keys.
q: 异构机器怎么放到哈希环上？
q_en: How should heterogeneous machines be placed on the hash ring?
options: 按容量给大机器更多虚拟节点
每台机器必须只有一个虚拟节点
让小机器保存所有元数据
把大机器只用于备份
options_en: Assign more virtual nodes to higher-capacity machines
Each machine must have exactly one virtual node
Make small machines store all metadata
Use large machines only for backups
why: 虚拟节点数量可以近似表达权重。大机器拥有更多环区间，就能承担更多 key 和请求。
why_en: Virtual-node count can represent weight, so larger machines own more ranges and more traffic.
tradeoff: 容量加权 vs 配置复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果所有服务器规格完全一致，平均分配虚拟节点更简单。
optionExplanations: 按容量比例给大机器分配更多虚拟节点，它在环上占的区间就成比例变多，能承担的 key 和请求也就更多。
强制每台机器只有一个虚拟节点，恰恰放弃了用虚拟节点数量表达容量差异的能力，大小机器会被同等对待。
让小机器保存所有元数据和“大机器该多分担流量”这个目标没有关系，反而会让本就吃紧的小机器更累。
把大机器只用于备份完全没有利用它更强的容量去分担正常读写流量，是资源利用上的浪费。
optionExplanations_en: Giving the bigger machine virtual nodes proportional to its capacity lets it claim a proportionally larger share of the ring, and so a proportionally larger share of keys and requests.
Forcing every machine to exactly one virtual node throws away the ability to express capacity differences through virtual-node count — big and small machines end up treated the same.
Having the small machine hold all the metadata has nothing to do with getting the big machine to carry more traffic, and would just add load onto the already-tighter small machine.
Using the big machine only for backups wastes its extra capacity instead of putting it to work on normal read/write traffic.

q: 一致性哈希能不能完全解决热点？
q_en: Can consistent hashing fully solve hotspots?
text: 一致性哈希能降低多个热门 key 碰到同一分片的概率，但一个{{单独超级热 key}}仍可能压垮自己的负责节点。
text_en: Consistent hashing lowers the chance that many popular keys land on one shard, but one {{single extremely hot key}} can still overload its owner.
why: 它解决的是分布问题，不是单 key 流量放大问题。单 key 热点通常要靠副本、读缓存、拆分或限流处理。
why_en: It improves distribution, not the traffic of one extremely hot item.

termDefinitions.meaning: 整体数据集中的一个分片，通常由某台或某组服务器负责。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shard is one partition of the full dataset, usually served by one server or replica group.

scenario: 缓存节点重启后 IP 可能变化，但节点名和机架信息稳定。哈希环需要稳定地放置服务器。
scenario_en: Cache node IPs may change after restart, but node names and rack metadata are stable; ring placement should remain stable.
q: 服务器上环时应优先哈希什么？
q_en: What should be hashed when placing servers on the ring?
options: 稳定的节点 ID 或名字
当前 CPU 使用率
当前连接数
随机数，每次启动重抽
options_en: A stable node ID or name
Current CPU usage
Current connection count
A random number regenerated on every startup
why: 环位置必须跟节点身份稳定绑定。用瞬时指标或随机数会让重启也变成一次数据迁移。
why_en: Ring positions must be tied to stable identity; transient metrics or randomness turn restarts into data movement.
tradeoff: 稳定路由 vs 动态负载响应
whenOtherWins: 如果系统做的是无状态请求负载均衡，实时负载信号可以参与调度。
optionExplanations: 节点名字或 ID 这类身份信息不会因为重启而改变，把它拿来做哈希输入，环上的位置才能在重启后保持不变。
当前 CPU 使用率会随时间波动，用它来决定环位置，节点每次负载变化都可能等效于换了个位置，路由完全不稳定。
当前连接数同样是瞬时值，用来做环定位会让位置随流量抖动，跟“稳定放置服务器”这个目标矛盾。
每次启动都重新抽随机数做环位置，等价于每次重启都相当于换了一台新机器，会触发不必要的大规模数据搬迁。
optionExplanations_en: A node's name or ID doesn't change across restarts, so hashing on that identity keeps its ring position stable even after the IP changes.
Current CPU usage fluctuates constantly; basing ring position on it means every load swing could look like the node moved, making routing completely unstable.
Current connection count is likewise a momentary value; positioning by it would make the ring shift with traffic, working against the goal of stable server placement.
Redrawing a random number on every startup is equivalent to swapping in a brand-new machine each restart, triggering unnecessary large-scale data migration.

q: 一致性哈希里，节点变更后哪些说法正确？
q_en: In consistent hashing, which statements about membership changes are correct?
options: 新增节点接管自己到逆时针前驱之间的区间
删除节点的区间交给顺时针后继
所有节点都必须重新哈希自己的全部 key
虚拟节点也按同样的区间规则迁移
options_en: A new node takes the range between itself and its counterclockwise predecessor
A removed node’s range moves to its clockwise successor
Every node must rehash all its keys
Virtual nodes follow the same range movement rule
why: 环模型的关键是相邻区间变化。虚拟节点只是多个逻辑位置，迁移规则没有变。
why_en: The ring changes adjacent ranges only, and virtual nodes follow the same range rule.
optionExplanations: 对，新节点接管的正是从它自己往逆时针方向到上一个节点之间的区间。
对，节点删除后，它原本负责的区间交给顺时针方向遇到的下一个节点接手。
环模型恰恰是为了避免这种全量重哈希才存在的，成员变化只影响相邻区间，不会波及所有节点的全部 key。
对，虚拟节点只是同一台物理机在环上的多个逻辑位置，每个位置各自遵守同样的相邻区间迁移规则。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the new node takes over exactly the segment from itself back to its counter-clockwise predecessor.
Right — once a node is removed, its segment gets handed to the next node found going clockwise.
The whole point of the ring model is avoiding this kind of full rehash — membership changes only touch neighboring segments, not every node's entire key set.
Right — virtual nodes are just multiple logical positions for the same physical machine on the ring, and each position follows the same neighboring-segment migration rule.
scenario: 缓存环上有 100 个物理节点、每个带 200 个虚拟节点，现在要下线一台并新增一台。
scenario_en: The cache ring has 100 physical nodes with 200 virtual nodes each, and you are removing one node while adding another.

scenario: 你把每台机器的虚拟节点从 100 提到 500 后，负载更平，但节点上下线时协调服务里的 ring 配置明显变大。
scenario_en: You raise virtual nodes per machine from 100 to 500; load is smoother, but ring configuration stored in coordination service grows.
q: 这个现象说明了什么取舍？
q_en: What tradeoff does this illustrate?
options: 虚拟节点越多，路由元数据和运维成本也会增加
虚拟节点越多，数据一致性一定越强
虚拟节点只能用于数据库，不能用于任何缓存
虚拟节点减少了所有网络跳数
options_en: More virtual nodes also increase routing metadata and operational cost
More virtual nodes always strengthen consistency
Virtual nodes are only for databases, not caches
Virtual nodes reduce all network hops
why: 虚拟节点是在统计上换更平的分布，不是免费的。数量太多会放大配置传播、故障迁移和调试成本。
why_en: Virtual nodes buy smoother distribution statistically, but too many increase configuration, migration, and debugging cost.
tradeoff: 分布方差 vs 元数据成本
whenOtherWins: 如果负载已经足够均衡，继续增加虚拟节点收益会变小。
optionExplanations: 对，虚拟节点从 100 提到 500 换来更平的负载，但每个虚拟节点都要占一份路由元数据，环配置、心跳和故障迁移的开销也跟着涨，这是一笔要算进去的成本。
虚拟节点调整的是负载在物理机之间怎么分布，不改变数据本身的复制或同步方式，跟一致性强度没有直接关系。
虚拟节点是一致性哈希通用的负载均衡手段，不限定用在数据库还是缓存，只要是按 key 路由的存储都能用。
虚拟节点改变的是 key 到物理机的映射关系，不会改变客户端和物理机之间实际的网络跳数。
optionExplanations_en: Right — going from 100 to 500 virtual nodes buys a flatter load, but every virtual node adds routing metadata, so ring config, heartbeats, and failover overhead all grow too — a cost that has to be counted in.
Virtual nodes change how load is distributed across physical machines; they don't change how data itself is replicated or synced, so they have no direct bearing on consistency strength.
Virtual nodes are a general load-balancing technique for consistent hashing, not limited to databases — any key-routed store, including caches, can use them.
Virtual nodes change the key-to-machine mapping; they don't change the actual number of network hops between a client and a physical machine.

scenario: 缓存有 5 台机器。你用 hash(key) % 5 存 key；后来缩到 4 台，hash 值不变但除数变了。
scenario_en: A cache has five servers and uses hash(key) % 5. It shrinks to four servers; hash values stay the same but the divisor changes.
q: 为什么取模缩容会误导客户端？
q_en: Why does modulo shrinkage misroute clients?
options: 同一个 key 的余数可能变成另一台机器
hash 函数在缩容后会直接返回空值
所有机器都会保存同一份数据
客户端会自动知道旧位置
options_en: The same key can map to a different remainder
The hash function returns null after scaling down
All machines store the same copy
Clients automatically know the old location
why: 取模把 key 位置绑定到 N。N 变了，余数就可能变，客户端会去新位置找旧数据。
why_en: Modulo ties placement to N, so changing N can send clients to a new owner for data stored elsewhere.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取余运算，hash(key) % N 会把哈希值压到 0 到 N-1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo returns the remainder, mapping hash(key) into 0 through N-1.

optionExplanations: 对，同一个 key 的哈希值没变，但除数从 5 变成了 4，余数很可能变成另一个数字，指向另一台机器。
hash 函数本身仍然正常返回一个值，取模缩容不会让它突然返回空值，出问题的是取模之后指向的机器。
取模分片本来就是把数据分散存放，缩容并不会让所有机器凭空拥有同一份数据的副本。
客户端并不会自动感知旧位置，它按新的除数重新计算余数，直接去新算出来的机器找数据，找不到就是缓存未命中。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the key's hash value stays the same, but the divisor drops from 5 to 4, so the remainder is likely to come out different and point at a different machine.
The hash function itself still returns a value fine; scaling down doesn't make it suddenly return nothing — the problem is which machine that value now points to.
Modulo sharding is built to spread data out, not replicate it — scaling down doesn't make every machine magically hold a copy of the same data.
The client has no automatic awareness of the old location — it just recomputes the remainder with the new divisor and looks there, and finding nothing is exactly what a cache miss is.

scenario: 缓存节点下线后，大量 key 被错误路由。缓存 miss 后，应用会去数据库回源。数据库平时只承受少量 miss。
scenario_en: After a cache node goes down, many keys are routed to the wrong cache nodes. Cache misses fall back to a database that normally handles only a small miss rate.
q: 为什么这会变成后端事故？
q_en: Why can this become a backend incident?
options: miss 流量会集中回源，数据库被突然放大
缓存命中率会自动升高
数据库会主动修复哈希环
所有请求都会自动变成异步任务被重放一遍
options_en: Miss traffic falls back at once and overloads the database
Cache hit rate automatically rises
The database repairs the hash ring by itself
All requests automatically become replayed async jobs
why: 大面积 miss 会把缓存平时吸收的重复读同时推回数据库。数据库只按少量 miss 设计时，就会被突发读压垮。
why_en: Broad cache misses send absorbed reads back to a database sized for only a small miss rate.
tradeoff: 路由稳定性 vs 后端保护
whenOtherWins: 如果缓存只是可选优化、数据库能承受全量读，重映射风险会小一些。

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存未命中，应用需要去后端数据源读取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache miss means the cache has no usable value, so the app reads from the backend store.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性哈希里把 key 和节点映射到同一圆环上的路由结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash ring maps keys and nodes onto the same consistent-hashing circle for routing.

optionExplanations: 大量 key 错路由时会同时 miss，缓存平时吸收的重复读会集中回源，数据库很容易被打满。
错误路由让命中率下降；只有 key 重新打到正确节点或回填后，命中率才可能恢复。
哈希环是应用或缓存客户端的路由配置，数据库不会知道更不会主动修复它。
miss 后通常要同步回源拿结果；异步化需要额外队列设计，不会自动发生。
optionExplanations_en: When many keys miss at once, reads the cache normally absorbs fall back together and can saturate the database.
Misrouting lowers the hit rate; it recovers only after keys hit the right nodes or get refilled.
The hash ring is routing config in the app or cache client; the database does not repair it.
A miss usually waits on a backend read; async fallback requires an explicit queue design.

scenario: 客户端拿到一个 key 的哈希值后，需要在环上找到负责节点。环上节点位置已经按哈希值排序。
scenario_en: A client has a key hash and needs to find the owner on a ring whose node positions are sorted by hash value.
q: 环上查找通常怎么实现？
q_en: How is lookup on the ring usually implemented?
options: 二分找后继，越界回开头
扫描所有 key-value 数据
随机节点广播确认
按节点加入时间倒序
options_en: Binary-search the successor and wrap at the end
Scan all key-value data
Broadcast to random nodes
Sort by reverse join time
why: 哈希环在实现上常是有序数组或树。查后继节点可以二分，越过尾部就 wrap 到最小位置。
why_en: A hash ring is often a sorted list or tree, so successor lookup can binary-search and wrap around at the end.
tradeoff: 快速路由 vs 维护有序环
whenOtherWins: 节点数极小的时候，线性扫描环位置也能接受。

termDefinitions.meaning: 查找超过哈希空间末尾时回到最小哈希位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wrap around means returning to the smallest hash position after passing the end of the hash space.

optionExplanations: 环上的节点位置本身已经按哈希值排好序，用二分查找后继节点很快，越过数组末尾就折回到最小位置，正好对应“环”这个拓扑。
扫描全部 key-value 数据是线性做法，节点数一多，每次查找都要付出远高于二分的代价。
随机节点广播确认引入了额外的网络往返和协调开销，跟“环上位置已排序、可以直接算出归属”这个前提完全不匹配。
按节点加入时间排序和环上按哈希值排序是两套不同的顺序，用加入时间找不出 key 该归属哪个哈希区间。
optionExplanations_en: Ring positions are already sorted by hash value, so binary search finds the successor quickly, and wrapping past the end of the array back to the smallest position matches the ring topology exactly.
Scanning every key-value pair is a linear approach, and as node count grows, every lookup pays far more than binary search would.
Broadcasting to random nodes for confirmation adds extra network round trips and coordination, at odds with the premise that ring positions are already sorted and can just be computed.
Node join order and ring hash order are two different orderings — join time can't tell you which hash segment a key belongs to.

q: 哈希环为什么能首尾相接？
q_en: Why can the hash space be treated as a ring?
text: 一致性哈希把固定范围的哈希空间看成从最小值到最大值的线段，再把{{最大值}}后面接回{{最小值}}。
text_en: Consistent hashing treats the hash space as a line from minimum to maximum, then connects the {{maximum}} back to the {{minimum}}.
why: 首尾相接后，每个 key 都能沿一个方向找到后继节点。这样最大哈希附近的 key 也有明确归属。
why_en: Closing the space into a ring lets every key find a successor, including keys near the maximum hash.

scenario: 四个物理节点各在环上放一个点。由于随机位置不均，一台机器负责的区间是另一台的 4 倍。
scenario_en: Four physical nodes each get one ring position. Random placement is uneven, and one machine owns four times another machine’s range.
q: 单点上环会带来什么后果？
q_en: What can happen when each physical node has only one ring point?
options: 分区大小方差大，机器负载可能明显倾斜
所有机器都会自然地拥有完全相等的区间
副本数会自动变成 4
读请求不再需要路由
options_en: Partition-size variance can be high, skewing machine load
Every machine naturally owns equal ranges
Replica count automatically becomes four
Reads no longer need routing
why: 哈希函数均匀不代表少量样本点一定均匀。节点点位少时，随机空隙会直接变成负载倾斜。
why_en: A uniform hash function does not guarantee even gaps with few samples, so sparse ring positions can create load skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: 环上相邻节点之间的一段哈希空间，通常由顺时针后继节点负责。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A partition is the hash-space interval between adjacent ring nodes, owned by the clockwise successor.

optionExplanations: 对，随机撒的四个点本身就可能一个占很大一段、一个占很小一段，方差一大，负责大区间的那台机器负载就会明显偏高。
哈希函数整体均匀不代表只撒四个点也一定均匀，样本点太少的时候，区间大小完全可能相差好几倍。
副本数是单独配置的策略，不会因为几个物理节点在环上的位置不均匀就自动变成 4。
环上的位置决定的是路由归属，读请求仍然需要按这套规则找到对应节点，不会因此不再需要路由。
optionExplanations_en: Right — with only four random points, one can easily land a much bigger span than another, and that variance directly shows up as one machine carrying noticeably more load.
A hash function being uniform overall doesn't mean four sample points land evenly — with so few samples, segment sizes can easily differ by several times.
Replica count is a separately configured policy — it doesn't automatically become 4 just because four physical nodes happen to sit unevenly on the ring.
Ring position decides ownership, and read requests still have to follow that rule to find the right node — it doesn't remove the need for routing.

scenario: 每台机器从 1 个环点增加到 200 个虚拟节点。目标不是改变副本数，而是让每台机器抽到更多小区间。
scenario_en: Each machine moves from one ring point to 200 virtual nodes. The goal is not changing replication, but giving each machine many smaller ranges.
q: 为什么更多虚拟节点能降低倾斜？
q_en: Why do more virtual nodes reduce skew?
options: 更多独立区间会把随机误差平均掉
每个虚拟节点都会保存完整数据集
虚拟节点会让网络距离变短
虚拟节点会让 key 不再需要哈希
options_en: More independent ranges average out random placement error
Each virtual node stores the full dataset
Virtual nodes shorten network distance
Virtual nodes remove the need to hash keys
why: 粗略理解是样本数变多后，大区间和小区间会在同一物理机上互相抵消。这个数字用于调负载方差，而不是背固定值。
why_en: More samples let large and small ranges average out per physical server, so the count tunes variance rather than a fixed magic value.
optionExplanations: 对，把一台机器拆成 200 个独立小区间后，大区间和小区间会在同一台物理机上互相抵消，整体落在这台机器上的总空间就更接近平均值。
虚拟节点只是环上的逻辑位置标记，不会让每个虚拟节点各自保存一份完整数据集，数据仍然按物理机存放。
虚拟节点改变的是逻辑映射，不会缩短客户端和物理机之间实际的网络距离。
虚拟节点仍然依赖对 key 做哈希来决定位置，不会让 key 跳过哈希这一步。
optionExplanations_en: Right — splitting one machine into 200 independent small segments lets the big and small draws cancel each other out on that same physical machine, so its total share converges closer to the average.
Virtual nodes are just logical position markers on the ring — they don't each hold a full copy of the dataset; data still lives on the physical machine.
Virtual nodes change the logical mapping, not the actual network distance between a client and a physical machine.
Virtual nodes still rely on hashing the key to decide position — they don't let a key skip hashing.

scenario: KV 系统在一致性哈希环上为每个 key 放 3 个副本。第一个副本是 key 的顺时针后继。
scenario_en: A KV system uses a consistent-hashing ring and keeps three replicas per key. The first replica is the key’s clockwise successor.
q: 后续副本通常怎么选？
q_en: How are the later replicas usually chosen?
options: 继续顺时针找后续不同物理节点
复制到同一机器的下两个虚拟节点
只写第一个节点，后台随机备份
按客户端所在城市选择
options_en: Continue clockwise to later distinct physical nodes
Copy to the next two virtual nodes on the same machine
Write only the first node and randomly back up later
Choose by the client’s city
why: 顺时针选择保持路由规则简单。跳过同一物理节点，才能让副本跨故障域。
why_en: Continuing clockwise keeps routing simple, while skipping the same physical server preserves failure isolation.
tradeoff: 确定性副本选择 vs 故障域隔离
whenOtherWins: 如果有机架和机房感知策略，副本选择还会额外跳过同机架或同机房节点。
optionExplanations: 继续沿顺时针方向找，但要求是不同的物理机，这样既保持路由规则简单，也能让副本分散到不同的故障域。
复制到同一台机器的下两个虚拟节点看似多了副本，其实这台机器一挂，几份副本会一起消失，起不到容错作用。
只写第一个节点、后台随机备份放弃了确定性路由，下次读的时候没法确定副本具体在哪。
按客户端所在城市选择副本，混入了跟数据放置规则无关的地理因素，会让副本归属变得不可预测。
optionExplanations_en: Continuing clockwise but requiring a different physical machine each time keeps the routing rule simple while still spreading replicas across separate failure domains.
Copying to the same machine's next two virtual nodes looks like more replicas, but if that one machine dies, all of them vanish together — it provides no real fault tolerance.
Writing only the first node and backing up randomly in the background gives up deterministic routing — the next read has no fixed way to know where the replicas actually are.
Picking replicas by the client's city mixes in a geography factor unrelated to the placement rule, making replica ownership unpredictable.

rows: 顺时针下一个不同物理节点
同机器下两个虚拟节点

q: 为什么一致性哈希适合缓存和 KV 分片？
q_en: Why does consistent hashing fit cache and KV sharding?
options: key 可以独立路由，不需要中心目录查每条记录
节点增删时只迁移相邻区间
虚拟节点能表达不同机器容量
它保证所有读取都是强一致的
options_en: Each key can be routed independently without a central per-record directory
Node changes move only adjacent ranges
Virtual nodes can represent different machine capacity
It guarantees every read is strongly consistent
why: 缓存和 KV 都是按 key 访问，天然适合哈希路由。一致性哈希解决的是路由和迁移，不直接解决一致性级别。
why_en: Cache and KV systems route by key, and consistent hashing handles ownership and movement rather than consistency guarantees.
optionExplanations: 对，一致性哈希只靠 key 本身算出归属节点，不需要维护一张记录每条数据在哪的中心目录。
对，这正是它相比取模分片的核心优势——成员变化时只搬相邻区间，不用全量重新映射。
对，通过给不同机器分配不同数量的虚拟节点，可以近似表达它们的容量差异。
一致性哈希只解决路由和迁移问题，副本之间是否强一致要看具体的复制协议，不是哈希方案本身保证的。
optionExplanations_en: Right — consistent hashing computes ownership purely from the key itself, with no need for a central directory tracking where every record lives.
Right — that's exactly its core edge over modulo sharding: membership changes only move a neighboring segment instead of remapping everything.
Right — assigning different machines different numbers of virtual nodes approximates their capacity differences.
Consistent hashing only solves routing and migration — whether replicas stay strongly consistent depends on the replication protocol, not something the hashing scheme itself guarantees.
scenario: 一个按 user_id 访问的 KV 缓存要求客户端直接算出分片，读路径不允许多一跳中心目录查询。
scenario_en: A KV cache addressed by user_id needs clients to compute the shard themselves, with no extra hop to a central directory on reads.

scenario: 缓存客户端本地保存环配置。新增节点后，如果一半客户端还没刷新配置，它们会按旧环路由。
scenario_en: Cache clients keep ring configuration locally. After adding a node, half of clients have not refreshed and still route using the old ring.
q: 环配置传播慢会造成什么？
q_en: What does slow ring-configuration propagation cause?
options: 同一个 key 可能被不同客户端打到不同节点
所有客户端都会自动读到两份完全重复的数据
数据库 schema 会损坏
虚拟节点会全部消失
options_en: Different clients may route the same key to different nodes
Every client automatically reads fully duplicated data
The database schema is corrupted
All virtual nodes disappear
why: 一致性哈希依赖大家看到同一张环。配置传播期间，新旧视图并存，会带来 miss、双写或短暂不一致。
why_en: Consistent hashing assumes a shared ring view; during propagation, old and new views can cause misses or inconsistent routing.
tradeoff: 客户端本地路由速度 vs 配置一致性
whenOtherWins: 如果所有请求都经过中心 proxy，配置更新可以集中处理，但 proxy 层会更重。
optionExplanations: 对，还没刷新配置的那部分客户端仍按旧环计算归属，同一个 key 在不同客户端眼里会指向不同节点，读写就可能落到不一致的地方。
配置没同步不会让客户端自动读到两份数据，实际发生的是各自读到自己算出来的那一份，可能是新节点也可能是旧节点。
环配置传播延迟是路由层面的问题，跟数据库表结构是否损坏完全不相关。
虚拟节点本身没有消失，只是不同客户端手里的环配置版本不一样，看到的虚拟节点布局不同而已。
optionExplanations_en: Right — clients that haven't refreshed still compute ownership off the old ring, so the same key can point at different nodes for different clients, and reads/writes can land inconsistently.
A stale config doesn't make clients automatically see two copies — what actually happens is each client reads whichever single copy its own (possibly outdated) calculation points to.
Ring config propagation delay is a routing-layer issue, entirely unrelated to whether a database's table schema gets corrupted.
The virtual nodes themselves haven't disappeared — different clients just hold different versions of the ring config and so see a different layout of them.

scenario: A 机器容量是 B 的两倍。你给 A 两倍数量的虚拟节点。
scenario_en: Machine A has twice the capacity of machine B, so A receives twice as many virtual nodes.
q: 加权虚拟节点的直接后果是什么？
q_en: What is the direct effect of weighted virtual nodes?
options: A 预期拥有约两倍哈希区间和流量
A 会负责保存 B 节点的所有数据副本
B 不再参与读写
强一致性自动提升
options_en: A is expected to own about twice the hash space and traffic
A stores every replica for B
B no longer serves reads or writes
Strong consistency is automatically improved
why: 虚拟节点数就是环上抽样权重。容量大的机器抽到更多区间，预期承载更多 key。
why_en: Virtual-node count acts as ring-sampling weight, so higher-capacity machines are expected to own more ranges.
optionExplanations: 对，虚拟节点数就是环上的抽样权重，A 拿到两倍数量的虚拟节点，预期也会拿到约两倍的哈希区间和相应流量。
虚拟节点数量影响的是 A 承担多少自己的区间，不会让 A 额外去保存 B 那部分数据的所有副本。
加权虚拟节点只是调整流量在 A、B 之间怎么分配，B 依然正常参与读写，不会被排除在外。
虚拟节点数量调的是负载分布，不涉及复制协议或一致性级别，不会自动带来更强的一致性保证。
optionExplanations_en: Right — virtual-node count is the sampling weight on the ring, so giving A twice as many means A is expected to draw roughly twice the hash space and traffic.
The virtual-node count decides how much of the ring A itself owns — it doesn't make A additionally hold every replica of B's data.
Weighted virtual nodes only shift how traffic splits between A and B — B still takes part in normal reads and writes, it isn't cut out.
Virtual-node count tunes load distribution, not the replication protocol or consistency level — it doesn't automatically buy stronger consistency.

scenario: 一个明星用户的资料 key 被每秒几十万次读取。即使整体分布均匀，这个 key 仍只归属一个主节点。
scenario_en: A celebrity profile key is read hundreds of thousands of times per second. Even with even distribution, that key has one primary owner.
q: 一致性哈希之后还要怎么处理单 hot key？
q_en: What should be done for one hot key even after consistent hashing?
options: 为该 key 做读副本、局部缓存或拆分
继续不停地增加普通虚拟节点直到问题消失
把整个集群改成取模分片
关闭缓存直接读数据库
options_en: Add read replicas, local cache, or split that key
Keep adding normal virtual nodes until it disappears
Switch the whole cluster to modulo sharding
Disable cache and read the database directly
why: 一致性哈希平衡的是很多 key 的分布。单个 key 的流量太大时，需要对这个 key 单独扩读或限流。
why_en: Consistent hashing balances many keys, but one extremely hot key needs targeted replication, caching, splitting, or limiting.
tradeoff: 通用分片均衡 vs 单 key 专项扩展
whenOtherWins: 如果热点来自很多热门 key 聚在一起，增加虚拟节点或重新加权更有效。
optionExplanations: 环分布均衡照顾的是一大批 key 的整体走势，这一个被打爆的 key 只能靠专门给它开读副本、就近放一份缓存，或者把它本身拆细来分担。
继续加普通虚拟节点调的是很多 key 之间的整体均衡度，改变不了这一个 key 始终只归属一个主节点这个事实。
把整个集群换成取模分片解决不了单 key 热点问题，取模在成员变化时反而会带来更大范围的重映射。
关闭缓存直接读数据库，会让原本被缓存挡住的这波超高频读求直接压向数据库，情况只会更糟。
optionExplanations_en: Ring balance takes care of the overall trend across many keys — this one key getting hammered needs its own dedicated read replicas, a nearby cache, or being split up to spread the load.
Adding more ordinary virtual nodes tunes the balance across many keys — it doesn't change the fact that this one key still belongs to exactly one primary node.
Switching the whole cluster to modulo sharding doesn't solve a single hot key problem, and modulo triggers even wider remapping whenever membership changes.
Turning off the cache and hitting the database directly sends this extremely high-frequency read straight at the database — it only makes things worse.

scenario: 你在设计 KV 路由。方案 A 是中心目录记录每个 key 在哪台机器；方案 B 是一致性哈希按规则计算归属。
scenario_en: You are designing KV routing. Option A stores every key owner in a central directory; option B computes ownership with consistent hashing.
q: 一致性哈希相比中心目录的取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the tradeoff of consistent hashing versus a central directory?
options: 少存每 key 路由，但只能按规则分布
能表达任意单 key 放置，但目录更大
完全不需要成员配置
每次查询都必须广播
options_en: Stores less per-key routing but follows rule-based placement
Can express arbitrary per-key placement but needs a larger directory
Needs no membership configuration
Must broadcast every query
why: 一致性哈希只要环元数据就能算路由。代价是不能随意指定每个 key 的机器，特殊 key 需要额外机制。
why_en: Consistent hashing computes routing from ring metadata, trading per-key flexibility for compact routing state.
tradeoff: 路由状态大小 vs 单 key 放置灵活性
whenOtherWins: 需要精确手工放置少数大对象时，目录表或元数据服务更灵活。
optionExplanations: 一致性哈希只需要存环元数据就能算出路由，代价是不能随意指定某个 key 该放在哪台机器，特殊需求要另外加机制。
中心目录能精确指定任意单个 key 放在哪台机器，但每条 key 的位置都要记一笔，目录会随数据量线性变大。
一致性哈希仍然需要知道环上有哪些成员节点，说完全不需要成员配置不准确。
路由是通过哈希计算或目录查找完成的，不需要每次查询都广播给所有节点确认。
optionExplanations_en: Consistent hashing only needs ring metadata to compute routing, at the cost of being unable to freely pin any given key to a specific machine — special cases need an extra mechanism.
A central directory can precisely pin any single key to any machine, but it has to record every key's location, so it grows linearly with data volume.
Consistent hashing still needs to know which nodes are in the ring — saying it needs zero membership configuration isn't accurate.
Routing is resolved through hash computation or a directory lookup — it doesn't require broadcasting to every node on each query.

q: 新增节点后迁移流程怎么讲？
q_en: How should you describe the migration flow after adding a node?
steps: 把新节点或虚拟节点加入环配置
计算新节点逆时针到前驱之间的 affected range
从旧 owner 复制或搬迁这段 range 的 key
确认数据可读后，让客户端使用新环版本
why: 迁移不是只改路由。要先算范围，再搬数据，最后切客户端视图，才能少 miss。
why_en: Adding a node is not just routing; calculate the range, move data, then shift clients to the new ring view.

scenario: 一个缓存节点要计划内下线维护。你想避免把它负责的区间直接变成 miss。
scenario_en: A cache node is being gracefully removed for maintenance, and you want to avoid turning its owned range directly into misses.
q: 计划内下线前最好做什么？
q_en: What should be done before planned removal?
options: 先把它负责的区间预热或迁到顺时针后继
直接杀进程让客户端自然 miss
删除整个环配置
把所有 key 复制到客户端
options_en: Prewarm or migrate its range to the clockwise successor
Kill the process and let clients naturally miss
Delete the entire ring configuration
Copy all keys to clients
why: 一致性哈希告诉你下线影响哪段区间。计划内下线可以提前搬这段，减少回源压力。
why_en: Consistent hashing identifies the affected range, so planned removal can prewarm or migrate it before traffic shifts.
tradeoff: 下线准备成本 vs 回源尖峰
whenOtherWins: 突发宕机来不及预热，只能依靠副本、重试和后端保护。
optionExplanations: 计划内下线可以提前知道这个节点负责哪段区间，把这段数据预热到顺时针后继或者提前迁过去，下线那一刻就不会突然变成大面积 miss。
直接杀进程让客户端自然 miss，等于把本可以提前规避的回源尖峰硬生生留到了下线那一刻。
删除整个环配置影响的不只是这一个节点，会连带打乱其他节点原本正常的路由。
把所有 key 复制到客户端既不现实也没必要，客户端不该承担存储整个数据集的角色。
optionExplanations_en: A planned takedown lets you know in advance which segment this node owns, so pre-warming or migrating that data to its clockwise successor means the moment it goes offline doesn't turn into a wave of misses.
Just killing the process and letting clients discover misses on their own turns an avoidable spike into one that hits right at takedown time.
Deleting the whole ring configuration doesn't just affect this one node — it disrupts routing for every other node too.
Copying every key down to the client is neither realistic nor necessary — the client shouldn't be the one holding the entire dataset.

scenario: 你换了一个哈希函数。新函数会把 key 和节点映射到完全不同的环位置。
scenario_en: You change the hash function, and the new function maps keys and nodes to completely different ring positions.
q: 为什么哈希函数也要稳定？
q_en: Why must the hash function stay stable?
options: 换函数接近重建整张环，会造成大规模迁移
换哈希函数只会影响之后新写入的那些 key
换函数能自动修复热点
换函数不影响节点位置
options_en: Changing it nearly rebuilds the ring and causes large movement
Changing it affects only newly written keys
It automatically fixes hot keys
It does not affect node positions
why: 一致性哈希减少的是节点集合变化的扰动，不是哈希函数变化的扰动。函数变了，key 和节点坐标都会变。
why_en: Consistent hashing limits membership-change disruption, not hash-function changes; a new function moves key and node coordinates.
optionExplanations: 对，哈希函数一换，几乎每个 key 和每个节点在环上的坐标都会跟着变，效果接近重建整张环，会触发大规模数据搬迁。
换哈希函数会重新计算所有 key 和节点的坐标，不会只影响新写入的 key，旧 key 的归属也一起变了。
换哈希函数只是改变了映射方式，不会自动识别或修复原有的热点问题。
换哈希函数恰恰会让节点在环上的坐标整体改变，说它不影响节点位置正好说反了。
optionExplanations_en: Right — swapping the hash function shifts nearly every key's and node's ring coordinates, effectively rebuilding the whole ring and triggering large-scale migration.
Changing the hash function recomputes coordinates for every key and node — it doesn't affect only newly written keys; existing keys' ownership shifts too.
Swapping the hash function just changes the mapping scheme — it doesn't automatically detect or fix pre-existing hot spots.
Swapping the hash function is exactly what shifts every node's ring coordinates — saying it doesn't affect node position has it backwards.

scenario: 产品要求按用户 ID 范围扫描数据，比如 userId 1000 到 2000。你考虑用一致性哈希分片。
scenario_en: Product requires scanning data by user ID range, such as userId 1000 through 2000. You consider consistent-hash sharding.
q: 一致性哈希对范围查询有什么代价？
q_en: What is the cost of consistent hashing for range scans?
options: 哈希打散顺序，范围查询会跨很多分片
范围查询天然会落在同一台机器上
不再需要二级索引
会自动按时间排序
options_en: Hashing destroys order, so range scans span many shards
Ranges naturally land on one machine
Secondary indexes are no longer needed
It automatically sorts by time
why: 一致性哈希适合点查 key。它会打散原始顺序，所以范围查询要查多个分片或建立额外索引。
why_en: Consistent hashing fits point lookups; it scatters original order, so range scans need many shards or extra indexes.
tradeoff: 点查均衡 vs 范围局部性
whenOtherWins: 如果核心访问是连续范围扫描，按范围分片可能更合适。
optionExplanations: 对，哈希会把原本连续的用户 ID 打散到环上完全不相邻的位置，一次范围扫描往往要跨很多个分片才能拼出完整结果。
一致性哈希追求的正是把连续 key 打散避免热点，范围恰好落在同一台机器上是极小概率的巧合，不能当成规律。
是否需要二级索引取决于查询模式本身，跟分片用一致性哈希还是别的方案没有直接关系。
一致性哈希只按 key 的哈希值决定位置，跟这些 key 原本的时间顺序毫无关系，不会自动按时间排序。
optionExplanations_en: Right — hashing scatters what were originally contiguous user IDs to completely unrelated ring positions, so a single range scan usually has to reach across many shards to assemble the full result.
Consistent hashing is specifically built to scatter contiguous keys and avoid hot spots — a range landing on one machine would be a rare coincidence, not something to rely on.
Whether a secondary index is needed depends on the query pattern itself, not directly on whether sharding uses consistent hashing or something else.
Consistent hashing decides position purely from a key's hash value, with no relation to the keys' original time order — it doesn't sort by time on its own.

q: 面试里讲一致性哈希，哪些点应该主动说？
q_en: What points should you proactively mention when explaining consistent hashing?
options: 取模在 N 变化时会大规模重映射
环上顺时针后继决定 key owner
虚拟节点改善均衡并支持容量权重
它自动提供事务隔离
options_en: Modulo remaps broadly when N changes
The clockwise successor on the ring owns the key
Virtual nodes improve balance and support capacity weights
It automatically provides transaction isolation
why: 这三个点覆盖问题、机制和工程调参。事务隔离是存储一致性问题，不是哈希路由本身提供的能力。
why_en: Those points cover the problem, mechanism, and tuning; transaction isolation is not provided by hash routing itself.
optionExplanations: 对，这是取模分片最大的短板，也是一致性哈希要解决的核心问题，面试里值得先点出来。
对，环上顺时针后继决定 key 归属，这是一致性哈希路由的核心机制，讲清楚这一点是基础。
对，虚拟节点既能改善分布均衡，又能通过数量差异表达不同机器的容量权重，是工程落地的关键调参点。
一致性哈希解决的是路由和分片问题，事务隔离属于存储引擎或数据库层的一致性保证，不是哈希方案自带的能力。
optionExplanations_en: Right — this is modulo sharding's biggest weakness and the core problem consistent hashing solves, worth stating up front.
Right — the clockwise successor deciding ownership is the core routing mechanism of consistent hashing, and it's foundational to explain.
Right — virtual nodes both smooth out balance and let node count express different machines' capacity weight, a key engineering knob in practice.
Consistent hashing solves routing and sharding — transaction isolation is a storage-engine or database-layer consistency guarantee, not something the hashing scheme provides on its own.
scenario: 面试里只有 3 分钟讲清缓存集群为什么从取模换成一致性哈希，必须挑最关键的点说。
scenario_en: You have three minutes in an interview to explain why a cache cluster moved from modulo hashing to consistent hashing.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Mod["取模分片"] -->|"N 变化"| Remap["大规模重映射"]
Remap --> Ring["哈希环：顺时针后继定归属"]
Ring --> VNode["虚拟节点：均衡 + 容量权重"]

scenario: 你要存大量小于 10KB 的键值对。单机内存哈希表延迟低，但数据量持续增长，内存放不下全量。
scenario_en: You store many key-value pairs under 10KB. A single in-memory hash table is fast, but the dataset keeps outgrowing memory.
q: 为什么要从单机 KV 转向分布式 KV？
q_en: Why move from a single-node KV store to a distributed KV store?
options: 因为哈希表不能存字符串
因为单机容量和故障域都会成为上限
因为分布式系统一定比单机更强一致
因为磁盘不能保存键值对
options_en: Because hash tables cannot store strings
Because single-node capacity and failure domain become limits
Because distributed systems are always more strongly consistent
Because disks cannot store key-value pairs
why: 单机方案可以用压缩和冷热分层拖一段时间，但容量和可用性迟早卡住。分布式 KV 用分片和副本把容量、流量、故障摊开。
why_en: Compression and hot-cold storage can delay the problem, but sharding and replication are needed to spread capacity, traffic, and failure risk.
tradeoff: 低复杂度单机 vs 可扩展分布式
whenOtherWins: 如果数据量很小、停机可接受，单机内存表加持久化会更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用唯一 key 查找对应 value 的存储系统，value 通常当作不透明字节处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A key-value store retrieves an opaque value by a unique key.

optionExplanations: 哈希表本身可以存字符串，问题不出在数据类型能不能存，而是单机放不下持续增长的总量。
对，压缩和冷热分层能撑一阵，但单机的内存容量、故障域迟早都会顶到天花板，这才是真正要转向分布式的原因。
分布式系统不是天然就更一致，它反而常常要在一致性和可用性之间做取舍，不能默认更强。
磁盘完全可以保存键值对，很多单机 KV 引擎就是基于磁盘的，这个选项对存储介质的判断是错的。
optionExplanations_en: A hash table can store strings just fine — the real limit isn't the data type, it's that a single machine can't hold a total that keeps growing.
Right — compression and hot/cold tiering can buy some time, but a single machine's memory ceiling and single failure domain eventually cap out, which is the actual reason to move to distributed.
A distributed system isn't automatically more consistent — it often has to trade consistency against availability, so it can't be assumed stronger by default.
Disk can absolutely hold key-value pairs; plenty of single-machine KV engines are disk-based, so this option's claim about the storage medium is simply wrong.

scenario: 三副本 KV 集群发生网络分区。n1、n2 能互通，n3 被隔离；系统必须继续面对客户端请求。
scenario_en: A three-replica KV cluster is partitioned: n1 and n2 can talk, n3 is isolated, and clients keep sending requests.
q: CAP 下此时真正要选什么？
q_en: What real CAP choice must be made during the partition?
options: 在一致性和可用性之间选一个优先
在 CPU 和内存之间选一个优先
在 SQL 和 NoSQL 之间选一个优先
在同步和压缩之间选一个优先
options_en: Prioritize consistency or availability
Prioritize CPU or memory
Prioritize SQL or NoSQL
Prioritize synchronization or compression
why: 分区容忍在真实分布式系统里不能放弃。分区发生时，要么拒绝可能不一致的操作，要么继续服务并接受旧数据风险。
why_en: Partition tolerance is unavoidable, so during a partition you either reject risky operations or keep serving with stale-data risk.
tradeoff: 一致性 vs 可用性
whenOtherWins: 没有跨节点通信故障的单机系统不需要用 CAP 做核心选择。

termDefinitions.meaning: Consistency、Availability、Partition Tolerance 三者在分区时不能同时满分的分布式系统定理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CAP says a distributed system cannot fully provide consistency, availability, and partition tolerance at the same time during partitions.

optionExplanations: 对，分区已经发生，分区容忍是无法放弃的前提，剩下能选的就是分区期间到底要一致性还是要可用性。
CPU 和内存之间的取舍是资源调度问题，跟网络分区导致节点互相看不见完全不是一回事。
SQL 和 NoSQL 是数据模型和查询能力的选择，不是分区发生时系统该怎么响应请求的问题。
同步和压缩都是实现细节，网络分区带来的是“还要不要继续服务”这个更高层的决策，不是这两者之间的取舍。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the partition has already happened and partition tolerance isn't optional, so the only real choice left is whether to favor consistency or availability while it lasts.
CPU versus memory is a resource-scheduling tradeoff, unrelated to nodes being unable to see each other during a network partition.
SQL versus NoSQL is about data model and query capability, not about how a system should respond to requests while partitioned.
Sync versus compression are implementation details; a network partition forces the higher-level question of whether to keep serving at all, not a choice between these two.

scenario: 银行余额 KV 发生副本分区。返回旧余额会造成资金风险，短暂报错可以接受。
scenario_en: A bank-balance KV store has a replica partition. Returning a stale balance is risky, while a short error is acceptable.
q: 这个场景更偏 CP 还是 AP？
q_en: Should this scenario prefer CP or AP behavior?
options: CP：阻止可能不一致的读写
AP：所有请求都返回，之后再修
CA：忽略网络分区
只用本地缓存回答
options_en: CP: block reads and writes that may be inconsistent
AP: return every request and repair later
CA: ignore network partitions
Answer only from local cache
why: 余额这种不变量比可用性更硬。分区期间宁可返回错误，也不要让用户看到或写入冲突状态。
why_en: For bank balances, the invariant is stricter than availability, so errors are safer than stale or conflicting values.
tradeoff: 资金正确性 vs 分区可用性
whenOtherWins: 如果是点赞数、最近浏览这类可容忍短暂旧值的数据，AP 会让体验更稳。
optionExplanations: 对，余额这种数字容不得含糊，宁可分区期间报错拒绝，也不能让用户看到或写入可能不一致的余额。
AP 先返回再修正的做法，对余额来说等于允许用户先花掉一笔可能不存在的钱，风险太大。
CA 假装分区不会发生，在真实的多副本网络环境里这个前提本身就不成立。
只用本地缓存回答绕不开副本之间到底谁的数据是权威的这个问题，余额场景不能靠本地猜测。
optionExplanations_en: Right — balances leave no room for ambiguity, so it's better to reject requests and error out during a partition than let a user see or write a possibly inconsistent balance.
The AP approach of returning first and fixing later effectively lets a user spend money that might not actually be there — too risky for a balance.
CA pretends partitions never happen, which isn't a valid assumption in any real multi-replica networked system.
Answering from local cache alone sidesteps the question of which replica actually holds the authoritative value — not something a balance can afford to guess at.

scenario: 一个大规模 KV 需要自动扩缩容，并希望节点增删时只迁移少量 key。
scenario_en: A large KV store needs automatic scaling and wants node joins and leaves to move only a small fraction of keys.
q: 数据分区应优先采用什么？
q_en: What partitioning method should it prefer?
options: 一致性哈希环
单机自增主键
按 key 字母首字母固定分 26 份
所有 key 广播到所有节点
options_en: A consistent-hashing ring
A single-node auto-increment key
Fixed 26 partitions by first letter
Broadcast every key to every node
why: 一致性哈希同时处理均匀分布和低迁移。配合虚拟节点，还能按机器容量做权重。
why_en: Consistent hashing addresses even distribution and low movement, and virtual nodes can encode server capacity.
tradeoff: 弹性分片 vs 简单静态分片
whenOtherWins: 如果 key 空间天然很小且固定，比如 26 个国家分区，静态规则可能够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点数变化时只让一部分 key 改变归属的分片方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing is a sharding method where membership changes move only part of the key space.

optionExplanations: 一致性哈希环能同时兼顾分布均匀和节点增删时的低迁移量，还能配合虚拟节点按机器容量加权，正好匹配大规模自动扩缩容的需求。
单机自增主键完全没有涉及数据该怎么分散到多台机器，跟分区方案不是一回事。
按字母首字母固定分 26 份是一种静态规则，节点数一变或某个字母下数据暴涨，都没法自动调整。
把所有 key 广播到所有节点等于让每台机器都存一份全量数据，既不省空间也不是分片的思路。
optionExplanations_en: A consistent-hash ring balances distribution evenly while keeping node-join/leave migration low, and pairing it with virtual nodes lets it weight by machine capacity — exactly what large-scale auto-scaling needs.
A single-machine auto-increment primary key says nothing about how data should be spread across multiple machines — it isn't a partitioning scheme at all.
Fixing 26 static buckets by first letter is a static rule that can't adapt when node count changes or one letter's data explodes.
Broadcasting every key to every node means every machine holds a full copy of everything — that's neither space-efficient nor what sharding is for.

scenario: KV 对每个 key 做 N=3 副本。哈希环使用大量虚拟节点，顺时针走时可能连续遇到同一物理服务器的多个虚拟节点。
scenario_en: A KV store keeps N=3 replicas per key. The ring uses many virtual nodes, so a clockwise walk may meet multiple virtual nodes from the same physical server.
q: 选择副本节点时要避免什么？
q_en: What should replica selection avoid?
options: 避免把多个副本放在同一物理服务器
避免跨越任何虚拟节点
避免把数据写到磁盘
避免所有副本拥有相同 key
options_en: Avoid placing multiple replicas on the same physical server
Avoid crossing any virtual node
Avoid writing data to disk
Avoid replicas having the same key
why: 虚拟节点是逻辑位置，不是独立故障域。同一物理机上的多个副本会被一次机器故障同时打掉。
why_en: Virtual nodes are logical positions, not independent failure domains, so replicas on the same machine fail together.
tradeoff: 副本独立性 vs 环遍历简单性
whenOtherWins: 如果只是本机多磁盘副本，物理故障域要求会不同，但它不能提供机器级高可用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次故障会同时影响的一组资源，比如同一机器、机架或机房。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A failure domain is the set of resources likely to fail together, such as one machine, rack, or data center.

optionExplanations: 虚拟节点只是环上的逻辑标签，同一台物理机的几个虚拟节点本质上还是一台机器，把多个副本放在它上面，一次硬件故障就会把这几份副本一起带走。
跨越虚拟节点是环遍历的正常动作，避免它反而会让副本选择规则变得别扭，不是这里真正要防的风险。
把数据写到磁盘是持久化的常规做法，跟副本该不该分散到不同物理机是两个不相关的问题。
副本本来就应该保存相同的 key，这是复制的基本前提，不是应该避免的事情。
optionExplanations_en: A virtual node is just a logical tag on the ring — several of them on the same physical machine are still one machine, so putting multiple replicas there means one hardware failure takes all of them out together.
Crossing virtual nodes is just normal ring traversal; avoiding it would actually make replica selection awkward, and it isn't the real risk here.
Writing data to disk is standard persistence practice, unrelated to whether replicas end up spread across different physical machines.
Replicas are supposed to hold the same key — that's the basic premise of replication, not something to avoid.

scenario: 同城机房偶尔会因电力或网络故障整体不可用。KV 希望一个机房掉线时用户仍能读写关键数据。
scenario_en: A whole data center may occasionally fail due to power or network issues, and the KV store should keep serving critical data.
q: 副本应该如何跨故障域放置？
q_en: How should replicas be placed across failure domains?
options: 尽量跨不同数据中心或机架
全部放在同一机架减少延迟
只在内存里保存副本
只复制最冷的 key
options_en: Spread replicas across data centers or racks when possible
Place all replicas in one rack to reduce latency
Keep replicas only in memory
Replicate only the coldest keys
why: 副本要跨独立故障域，才不会被一次机房事故一起带走。代价是跨机房复制延迟和带宽成本。
why_en: Replicas must cross independent failure domains to survive a site outage, at the cost of latency and bandwidth.
tradeoff: 容灾能力 vs 跨域成本
whenOtherWins: 如果是极低延迟的本地缓存，可能先同机房多副本，再用异步链路做远端备份。
optionExplanations: 跨不同数据中心或机架放置副本，才能让一次机房级事故最多只带走其中一份，而不是把所有副本一起带走。
全部放在同一机架确实延迟更低，但一旦这个机架断电或断网，所有副本会同时消失，跟“机房掉线仍能读写”的目标正相反。
只在内存里保存副本解决的是访问速度问题，完全没有回答副本该分布在哪些物理位置来抗机房级故障。
只复制最冷的 key 意味着大部分关键数据仍然只有单份，一旦这个机房故障，热数据反而没有容灾能力。
optionExplanations_en: Spreading replicas across separate datacenters or racks means one facility-level incident can only take out one copy, not all of them at once.
Putting them all on the same rack does lower latency, but the moment that rack loses power or network, every replica disappears together — the opposite of surviving a datacenter outage.
Keeping replicas only in memory addresses access speed, not the question of which physical locations replicas should be spread across to survive a facility failure.
Replicating only the coldest keys leaves most of the critical data with a single copy — exactly the hot data that needs disaster recovery the most.

scenario: KV 有 N=3 个副本。写操作等 W=2 个副本 ACK，读操作等 R=2 个副本返回；你想让读集合和写集合至少重叠一个副本。
scenario_en: A KV store has N=3 replicas. Writes wait for W=2 replica acknowledgments and reads wait for R=2 replica responses, so read and write quorums overlap.
q: 为什么 W + R > N 能提高一致性？
q_en: Why does W + R > N improve consistency?
options: 因为读写集合必然至少有一个交集副本
因为所有请求都会只打到 leader
因为副本数会自动变成 5
因为网络分区不会再发生
options_en: Because read and write sets must share at least one replica
Because all requests go only to a leader
Because the replica count automatically becomes 5
Because network partitions stop happening
why: 公式是 W + R > N。以 N=3、W=2、R=2 为例，写集合有 2 个副本、读集合也有 2 个副本；在 3 个副本里两组一定至少重叠 1 个，所以读有机会看到最新写入的版本。
why_en: The formula is W+R>N. With N=3, W=2, and R=2, the write set has 2 replicas and the read set also has 2 replicas; among only 3 replicas, they must overlap by at least one replica, so the read can observe the latest written version.
codeSample:
N = 3
W = 2
R = 2

put(key, value):
  replicas = pick_N_replicas(key, N)
  wait_until(ack_count(replicas, value) >= W)
  return "write ok"

get(key):
  versions = read_from_at_least_R_replicas(key, R)
  return newest_version(versions)  # overlaps with W when W + R > N

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次操作成功前必须参与或确认的最小副本数量；读写 quorum 讨论的是 R 个读响应和 W 个写确认是否会相交。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quorum is the minimum number of replicas that must participate or acknowledge before an operation succeeds; read/write quorum reasoning asks whether R read responses overlap W write acknowledgments.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本总数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: N is the total number of replicas.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写成功前需要收到确认的副本数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: W is the number of replica acknowledgments required for a write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 读成功前需要等待响应的副本数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: R is the number of replica responses required for a read.

optionExplanations: 对，N=3 里挑两个 2 人小组，无论怎么挑，两组之间至少会有一个人同时在场——这正是保证读能碰到最新写的数学基础。
coordinator 转发到副本集合，不代表所有请求都被压缩成只打给一个 leader，quorum 模型本身不要求固定 leader。
副本数是预先配置好的容量决策，不会因为 W、R 的取值变化就自动从 3 涨到 5。
W+R>N 讨论的是读写集合怎么重叠，跟网络分区还会不会发生是两个独立的问题，它并不能阻止分区。
optionExplanations_en: Right — picking any two 2-person groups out of 3 people, some person always ends up in both groups no matter how you pick — that overlap is exactly the math behind guaranteeing a read can catch the latest write.
The coordinator forwarding to a set of replicas doesn't mean every request funnels through one fixed leader — the quorum model itself doesn't require one.
Replica count is a capacity decision made ahead of time — it doesn't auto-grow from 3 to 5 just because W or R changes.
W+R>N is about whether the read and write sets overlap; it's a separate question from whether network partitions still occur, and it can't prevent them.

scenario: KV 的读流量远大于写流量。业务希望读延迟最低，但写请求可以等所有副本确认。N=3。
scenario_en: Read traffic is much higher than write traffic. The business wants lowest read latency, while writes can wait for every replica. N=3.
q: 应该怎么调 R 和 W？
q_en: How should R and W be tuned?
options: R=1，W=N
R=N，W=1
R=N，W=N 且拒绝缓存
options_en: R=1, W=N
R=N, W=1
R=N, W=N and forbid cache
why: R=1 让读只等一个副本，读路径最快。W=N 把一致性成本放到写路径上，适合写少读多。
why_en: R=1 makes reads wait for one replica, while W=N pushes the consistency cost to the less frequent write path.
tradeoff: 读延迟 vs 写延迟
whenOtherWins: 如果写入极多而读可以慢一点，W=1、R=N 会把等待成本挪到读路径。
optionExplanations: 读只等一个副本确认，读路径几乎不用等待；写等全部副本确认，把一致性成本压到写这一侧，正好匹配读多写少还想要低读延迟的诉求。
读要等全部副本、写只等一个，会把等待成本压到读这一侧，跟这里想要的低读延迟目标正好反过来。
R 和 W 都设为 0 等于读写都不等任何副本确认，既没有一致性保证，也没法判断写是否真的成功。
要求所有副本都确认还要禁用缓存，会让读写延迟同时变高，跟“读延迟最低”的目标完全不搭。
optionExplanations_en: Reads waiting on just one replica keep the read path nearly wait-free, while writes waiting on every replica push the consistency cost onto the write side — exactly the fit for read-heavy traffic that wants low read latency.
Waiting on all replicas for reads but just one for writes pushes the waiting cost onto the read side, the opposite of the low-read-latency goal here.
Setting both R and W to 0 means neither reads nor writes wait for any replica acknowledgment — no consistency guarantee, and no way to even confirm a write succeeded.
Requiring every replica to confirm and disabling caching would push both read and write latency up together, completely at odds with the goal of minimal read latency.

scenario: 购物车 KV 希望分区时继续接收写入。用户短时间看到旧购物车可以接受，但最终必须收敛。
scenario_en: A shopping-cart KV store wants to keep accepting writes during partitions. Users may briefly see old carts, but replicas must converge eventually.
q: 更适合哪种一致性模型？
q_en: Which consistency model fits best?
options: 最终一致性
强一致性且分区时阻塞所有操作
只读一致性，不同步写
完全不复制
options_en: Eventual consistency
Strong consistency that blocks all operations during partitions
Read-only consistency with no write sync
No replication at all
why: 购物车更看重可用性，短暂旧值通常可通过合并修复。最终一致性接受中间分歧，但要求后台传播后收敛。
why_en: Shopping carts usually value availability, so eventual consistency allows temporary divergence while requiring convergence later.
tradeoff: 可用性 vs 立即一致
whenOtherWins: 如果是库存扣减或余额变更，强一致或条件写会更合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: 如果不再有新写入，副本最终会传播到同一个值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means replicas converge to the same value if no new updates occur.

optionExplanations: 对，购物车更怕在分区时被拒绝写入，短暂看到旧内容通常能接受，事后再靠合并策略把分歧收敛掉。
强一致且分区时阻塞所有操作意味着用户分区期间连加购物车都做不了，跟“继续接收写入”的要求正好相反。
只读一致性、不同步写会让不同客户端的购物车数据长期对不上，根本没有解决“最终必须收敛”的要求。
完全不复制意味着只要保存副本的那台机器一挂，购物车数据就直接丢了，跟保持可用性的目标背道而驰。
optionExplanations_en: Right — a shopping cart fears being blocked during a partition far more than showing slightly stale contents, and those stray differences can be merged back together later.
Strong consistency that blocks all operations during a partition means the user can't even add to their cart while it lasts — the opposite of "keep accepting writes."
Read-only consistency with no write sync would leave different clients' carts permanently out of alignment, never actually meeting the requirement to eventually converge.
No replication at all means the cart data is simply gone the moment its one machine dies — the opposite of staying available.

scenario: 同一个 key 的两个客户端都从版本 D2 读出，然后分别写成 D3 和 D4。系统需要判断谁覆盖谁，还是两个版本冲突。
scenario_en: Two clients read version D2 of the same key, then write D3 and D4. The system must decide whether one overwrites the other or they conflict.
q: 向量时钟解决什么问题？
q_en: What problem do vector clocks solve?
options: 判断版本的因果先后和并发冲突
压缩 value 的字节数
给每个请求做负载均衡
保证网络永不分区
options_en: Detect causal order and concurrent conflicts between versions
Compress the value bytes
Load-balance each request
Guarantee that networks never partition
why: 向量时钟记录每个写入参与者的计数，用来判断 happens-before。D3 和 D4 都从 D2 分叉、互相没看见，所以它们是并发版本，不能只按墙钟早晚覆盖。
why_en: Vector clocks track per-writer counters, so D3 and D4 that both fork from D2 are concurrent versions rather than safe timestamp overwrites.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  D2[D2] --> D3[D3 from Sy]
  D2 --> D4[D4 from Sz]
  D3 --> C{compare clocks}
  D4 --> C
  C --> S[sibling conflict]

termDefinitions.meaning: 随数据保存的一组参与者版本计数，用来判断因果关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vector clock is a set of per-participant version counters stored with data to infer causality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 因果先后关系：如果 B 是在看到或依赖 A 之后产生的，就说 A happens-before B。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Happens-before is causal order: A happens-before B if B was produced after seeing or depending on A.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实钟表时间或机器时间戳；它能表示早晚，但在分布式系统里不等于因果关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wall-clock time is real clock time or a machine timestamp; it can order timestamps but does not prove causality in a distributed system.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有 happens-before 关系的两个版本；它们可能墙钟时间不同，但逻辑上互相没看见。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concurrent versions have no happens-before relationship; their wall-clock timestamps may differ, but logically neither saw the other.

rows: D3/D4 都从 D2 分叉

optionExplanations: 对，向量时钟要回答的正是 D3 和 D4 谁先谁后、还是彼此互不知道对方的并发分支，这是判断因果关系而不是墙钟时间。
向量时钟记录的是每个写入者的计数，跟 value 字节数怎么压缩完全不相关。
请求该转发到哪个副本是路由和负载均衡的职责，向量时钟只负责标注版本的因果关系。
向量时钟是在假设网络分区会发生的前提下才有意义的机制，它不能也不负责保证网络永不分区。
optionExplanations_en: Right — vector clocks exist to answer exactly whether D3 and D4 have a causal order or are concurrent branches neither side saw — that's about causality, not wall-clock time.
A vector clock tracks each writer's counter — it has nothing to do with how many bytes the value compresses down to.
Deciding which replica to forward a request to is a routing/load-balancing job — vector clocks only label the causal relationship between versions.
Vector clocks are meaningful precisely because network partitions can happen — they neither guarantee nor are responsible for preventing partitions.

scenario: KV 使用向量时钟检测到两个 sibling 版本。系统把两个版本都返回给客户端，让客户端合并后再写回。
scenario_en: A KV store uses vector clocks and detects two sibling versions. It returns both to the client, which merges them and writes back.
q: 这种冲突解决的主要代价是什么？
q_en: What is the main cost of this conflict-resolution style?
options: 客户端要理解业务语义并实现合并逻辑
服务器不能再存任何副本
所有读都会变成全表扫描
key 必须改成 128-bit
options_en: The client must understand business semantics and implement merge logic
The server can no longer store replicas
Every read becomes a full table scan
Keys must become 128-bit
why: 冲突是否能合并，常常只有业务知道。把 sibling 交给客户端能保留可用性，但客户端复杂度会上升。
why_en: Only the application often knows how to merge siblings, so availability is preserved at the cost of client complexity.
tradeoff: 服务端可用性 vs 客户端复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果业务不能容忍客户端合并，服务端应使用强一致条件写或事务边界。

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一旧版本分叉出来、没有因果覆盖关系的并发版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sibling versions are concurrent versions that diverged from a common ancestor without one causally superseding the other.

optionExplanations: 对，两份 sibling 到底要怎么合并成一份，往往只有懂业务语义的客户端才知道，服务端把这个判断权交出去，代价就是客户端逻辑变复杂。
服务器仍然照常存储各个副本，这种冲突解决方式没有取消存副本这件事。
读操作照样按 key 定位到对应副本读取，不会因为多了合并逻辑就变成全表扫描。
key 的长度或位数跟版本冲突该怎么合并没有关系，这个选项混淆了两个不同的层面。
optionExplanations_en: Right — only the client, who understands the business meaning, usually knows how two siblings should be merged into one, and pushing that decision out to the client is exactly what adds complexity there.
The server keeps storing each replica as usual — this conflict-resolution approach doesn't remove replica storage at all.
Reads still look up the right replica by key as normal — adding merge logic doesn't turn that into a full table scan.
Key length or bit-width has nothing to do with how version conflicts get merged — this option conflates two unrelated layers.

scenario: KV 集群有上千台节点。你不能让每台机器都向所有其他机器发心跳，但又需要传播成员状态。
scenario_en: A KV cluster has thousands of nodes. Each node cannot heartbeat every other node, but membership status must spread.
q: 故障检测更适合用什么？
q_en: What failure detection method fits better?
options: gossip 协议传播心跳计数
全量 all-to-all 心跳
只相信单个节点的一次报告
客户端访问失败就永久下线节点
options_en: Use a gossip protocol to spread heartbeat counters
Use full all-to-all heartbeats
Trust one report from one node
Permanently remove a node after one client failure
why: gossip 让每个节点只和随机少量节点交换成员表，状态会逐步扩散。规模大时，它比 all-to-all 的连接和消息成本低很多。
why_en: Gossip exchanges membership with a small random peer set, spreading state without all-to-all traffic.
tradeoff: 传播延迟 vs 消息规模
whenOtherWins: 几十台以内的小集群可以用更简单的集中式健康检查。

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点周期性和少量随机节点交换成员状态，让信息像传言一样扩散。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gossip protocol lets nodes periodically exchange membership state with a few random peers so information spreads through the cluster.

optionExplanations: 对，每个节点只需要跟随机挑的少数几个节点交换成员表，状态会像流言一样逐步扩散到全网，连接和消息成本远低于全量心跳。
上千台节点两两互相发心跳，连接数和消息量会随节点数平方级增长，规模上来后完全撑不住。
只信一个节点的单次报告很容易被一次误报或短暂网络抖动带偏，缺乏交叉验证的容错能力。
客户端访问失败一次就永久下线节点，会把一次偶然的网络抖动误判成永久故障，容错性太差。
optionExplanations_en: Right — each node only exchanges membership state with a handful of random peers, letting it spread across the whole cluster like a rumor, at a fraction of the connection and message cost of full heartbeats.
Thousands of nodes all pinging each other means connections and messages grow roughly with the square of the node count — it simply can't survive at that scale.
Trusting a single node's one report is easily thrown off by a false report or a brief network blip, with no cross-checking to add fault tolerance.
Permanently marking a node down after one failed client access misreads an occasional network blip as a permanent failure — too fragile.

q: gossip 如何把节点下线信息传播出去？
q_en: How does gossip spread the information that a node is down?
steps: 节点把这个成员状态发给一组随机节点
本地成员表记录每个节点的心跳计数
多个节点都观察到 s2 心跳长期不增加
接收方更新成员表，并继续向其他节点传播
why: 这条链要说清楚不是单点拍脑袋判死，而是心跳停滞被多处观察，再逐步传播。
why_en: The key is that failure is inferred from stalled heartbeats observed and propagated by multiple nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 节点周期性发出的存活信号，通常带计数或时间戳。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A heartbeat is a periodic liveness signal, often carrying a counter or timestamp.

scenario: 一个副本 s2 临时不可达。严格 quorum 会让读写阻塞，但产品更看重故障期间继续服务。
scenario_en: Replica s2 is temporarily unreachable. Strict quorum would block operations, but the product values continued service during failures.
q: 临时故障时怎么提高可用性？
q_en: How can availability be improved during a temporary failure?
options: sloppy quorum 和 handoff
严格 quorum，一直阻塞直到 s2 恢复为止
删除 s2 上的旧副本并重建
把 W 和 R 都设成 N+1
options_en: Sloppy quorum and handoff
Strict quorum, blocking until s2 recovers
Delete and rebuild the old s2 replica
Set both W and R to N+1
why: sloppy quorum 先让健康节点代收请求，hinted handoff 在 s2 回来后把代收的数据交回。代价是恢复前可能读到不完整或旧版本。
why_en: Sloppy quorum keeps serving through healthy nodes, and hinted handoff returns the temporary writes when the failed replica recovers.
tradeoff: 故障期可用性 vs 临时不一致
whenOtherWins: 如果系统必须严格读到最新确认写，临时故障时应坚持严格 quorum 或报错。

termDefinitions.meaning: 故障时不强制选择原定副本，而是选择足够数量的健康节点完成操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sloppy quorum uses enough healthy nodes during failures instead of strictly using the original replica set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 健康节点临时代管故障副本的数据，并在故障副本恢复后交回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hinted handoff stores data temporarily for a failed replica and hands it back after recovery.

optionExplanations: 先让健康节点临时代收请求，等 s2 恢复后再把代收的数据交还，这样故障期间业务照样能读写，只是要接受回交完成前可能存在的短暂不完整。
坚持严格 quorum 直到 s2 恢复，意味着 s2 不可达期间读写会一直被阻塞，跟“故障期间继续服务”的要求正好相反。
删除 s2 上的旧副本并重建是针对彻底损坏节点的恢复手段，跟“s2 只是临时不可达”这个前提不匹配，容易造成数据丢失。
把 W 和 R 都设成 N+1 意味着永远凑不齐这么多副本确认，写和读会直接卡死，比严格 quorum 还要糟糕。
optionExplanations_en: Letting a healthy node temporarily stand in for the unreachable one, then handing the data back once it returns, keeps the business serving reads and writes throughout the outage — the cost is possible short-lived incompleteness before that handoff finishes.
Sticking to strict quorum until s2 recovers means reads and writes stay blocked the whole time s2 is unreachable — the opposite of continuing to serve during the outage.
Deleting s2's old replica and rebuilding is a recovery move for a permanently damaged node, not a match for "s2 is just temporarily unreachable," and risks losing data.
Setting both W and R to N+1 means that many acknowledgments can never be gathered — reads and writes just stall outright, worse than plain strict quorum.

scenario: 一个副本长时间离线后被替换。新副本需要和其他副本对齐，但全量传输 TB 级数据太慢。
scenario_en: A replica is permanently replaced after being offline. The new replica must catch up, but transferring terabytes in full is too slow.
q: 如何减少副本修复的数据量？
q_en: How can replica repair transfer less data?
options: Merkle tree repair
在所有副本之间全量复制整个数据集
只比较两边文件的总字节数
只同步最近一分钟
options_en: Merkle-tree repair
Copy the entire dataset across all replicas
Compare only total file byte counts on both sides
Sync only the last minute
why: Merkle tree 从根哈希开始比较，一层层定位不同的 bucket。传输量跟差异大小相关，而不是跟全量数据大小相关。
why_en: Merkle trees compare hashes top-down to locate different buckets, so repair traffic tracks the differences rather than the full dataset.
tradeoff: 修复带宽 vs 哈希树维护成本
whenOtherWins: 如果数据集很小，全量复制可能更快也更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 叶子是数据块哈希、父节点是子哈希组合的树，用来快速定位差异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Merkle tree is a hash tree whose parent hashes summarize child hashes, making differences easy to locate.

optionExplanations: 从根哈希开始逐层比较，能一路定位到具体哪个小范围数据不一致，只需要传输真正有差异的那部分，不用管数据总量有多大。
全量复制整个数据集意味着传输量固定等于数据总量，TB 级数据下会慢到不可接受，正是题目想避开的做法。
只比较文件总大小连“哪里不一样”都定位不出来，大小相同也可能内容完全不同，起不到定位差异的作用。
只同步最近一分钟会漏掉更早之前就存在的历史差异，没法保证新副本和其他副本真正对齐。
optionExplanations_en: Comparing hashes level by level from the root narrows down to exactly which small range of data actually differs, so only that real delta needs transferring, regardless of total data size.
Copying the entire dataset makes the transfer size fixed at the full data volume, unbearably slow at terabyte scale — precisely what this is trying to avoid.
Comparing only total file size can't even locate where the difference is — two files the same size can still have entirely different contents.
Syncing only the last minute misses older discrepancies that existed before that window, so it can't guarantee the new replica actually matches the others.

q: Merkle tree 如何定位副本差异？
q_en: How does a Merkle tree locate replica differences?
steps: 把 key 空间切成 bucket
为 bucket 内 key 或数据块计算哈希
自底向上合成父节点哈希直到根
两个副本先比根，不同再递归比较子节点
why: 这条链说明它为什么不用全量逐 key 比较。根相同就停，根不同才下钻到有差异的 bucket。
why_en: The tree avoids full key-by-key comparison by drilling down only where hashes differ.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为了限制树深度而划出的 key 范围或分组。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bucket is a key range or group used to bound the depth of the repair tree.

scenario: KV 使用类似 Cassandra 的写路径。进程可能在写入后、刷盘前崩溃，但已确认的写不能丢。
scenario_en: A Cassandra-like KV write path may crash after accepting a write but before flushing memory to disk, and acknowledged writes must not be lost.
q: 为什么写入要先落 commit log？
q_en: Why should writes hit the commit log first?
options: 崩溃后可以从日志重放恢复 memtable
commit log 用来加速点查
commit log 替代了所有副本
因为 SSTable 只能存在于内存里无法落盘
options_en: The log can be replayed after a crash to rebuild the memtable
The commit log speeds up point reads
The commit log replaces all replicas
Because SSTables can only live in memory
why: 正常路径是先追加 commit log，再写 memtable，之后刷成 SSTable。崩溃时内存丢了，但日志还在；恢复要重放，代价是写放大和恢复时间。
why_en: The commit log is appended before the memtable so a crash can replay acknowledged writes, trading durability for write amplification and recovery time.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  W[write] --> CL[commit log]
  CL --> MT[memtable]
  MT --> SS[SSTable flush]

termDefinitions.meaning: 追加式写前日志，用来在崩溃后重放已确认写入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A commit log is an append-only write-ahead log used to replay acknowledged writes after a crash.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内存中的有序写缓冲，达到阈值后刷到磁盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A memtable is an in-memory sorted write buffer that later flushes to disk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不可变、按 key 排序的磁盘键值文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SSTable is an immutable sorted on-disk key-value file.

optionExplanations: 对，崩溃后内存里的 memtable 没了，但日志还在磁盘上，重放这份日志就能把已确认的写入重新灌回内存，恢复出崩溃前的状态。
commit log 是按顺序追加写的日志文件，不是为点查设计的索引结构，用它加速点查并不是它的作用。
commit log 是崩溃恢复用的日志，不是副本，它不能替代跨机器的多份数据拷贝。
SSTable 本来就是要落盘的不可变文件，说它只能存在内存里正好说反了。
optionExplanations_en: Right — after a crash the memtable in memory is gone, but the log survived on disk, so replaying it rebuilds the confirmed writes back into memory, restoring the pre-crash state.
A commit log is a sequentially appended file, not an index built for point lookups — speeding up point queries isn't what it's for.
