Right — adding caching to the read-heavy redirect path to protect the database shows judgment about the read/write ratio and where the bottleneck actually sits.
A short-link service is exactly the kind of target abuse and junk links gravitate toward — ignoring that real risk makes the design look incomplete, not something worth saying.
scenario: 面试只剩 5 分钟，面试官想听你把短链设计从容量估算一路讲到读路径和滥用风险。
scenario_en: With five minutes left, the interviewer wants you to connect capacity estimation all the way to the read path and abuse risks.

scenario: 搜索索引爬虫每月抓 10 亿个 HTML 页面，平均 500 KB，要保留 5 年原始内容。
scenario_en: A search-index crawler downloads 1 billion HTML pages per month, averages 500 KB per page, and stores raw content for five years.
q: 这个规模先推出哪两个容量锚点？
q_en: Which two capacity anchors should you derive first?
text: 平均抓取吞吐约 {{400 pages/s}}；原始内容存储约 {{30 PB}}，因为 10 亿 * 500 KB * 12 * 5。
text_en: Average crawl throughput is about {{400 pages/s}}; raw-content storage is about {{30 PB}} from 1B * 500 KB * 12 * 5.
why: 400 pages/s 决定下载器和队列吞吐；30 PB 说明内容主体不能靠内存，必须落盘并分片。峰值通常再乘 2 做余量。
why_en: The crawl QPS drives downloader and queue capacity, while the PB-scale storage forces disk-backed sharded storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: Queries Per Second，每秒请求数；这里指每秒下载页面数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS means Queries Per Second; here it is pages downloaded per second.

termDefinitions.meaning: Petabyte，约 1000 TB 量级的存储单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A petabyte is a storage unit on the order of one thousand terabytes.

scenario: 你从少量种子 URL 扩展整个 Web，链接图可能很深，还会遇到无限目录。
scenario_en: You start from seed URLs and expand the web graph, which may be very deep and may contain infinite-looking paths.
q: 遍历策略默认选哪个？
q_en: Which traversal strategy should be the default?
options: 深度优先 DFS，沿着一条路径一直深入追到最底
广度优先 BFS，配合 URL frontier
随机跳转，不维护队列
只抓种子域名首页
options_en: Depth-first DFS, following one path all the way down
Breadth-first BFS with a URL frontier.
Random jumps without a queue.
Fetch only seed-domain home pages.
why: 我会用 BFS 思路，但真正实现要靠 frontier 控制优先级和礼貌性。纯 DFS 容易陷进很深的路径，抓不到更广的站点。
why_en: Use BFS as the base traversal, then let the frontier handle priority and politeness because raw DFS can sink into deep paths.
tradeoff: 覆盖广度 vs 深路径风险
whenOtherWins: 如果只是调试单个站点的一条链路，DFS 更容易快速复现路径问题。

termDefinitions.meaning: Depth-First Search，优先沿一条路径向深处走。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DFS explores one path deeply before backtracking.

termDefinitions.meaning: Breadth-First Search，先扩展近邻，再逐层向外。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS expands nearby nodes first, then moves level by level.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存待抓 URL 的调度层，不只是普通队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A URL frontier is the scheduling layer for URLs waiting to be crawled.

optionExplanations: 链接图可能很深还有无限目录，BFS 配合 frontier 能先在广度上铺开，不会一头扎进一条深不见底的路径出不来。
一路追到底的 DFS 一旦撞上无限目录，会把预算全耗在这一条路径上，探不到更多别的站点。
随机跳转不维护队列，既没法保证覆盖广度，也没法控制抓取节奏和优先级。
只抓种子域名首页会漏掉整个 Web 图里绝大多数可达的页面，跟“扩展整个 Web”的目标不符。
optionExplanations_en: With a link graph that can run deep and hit infinite directories, BFS paired with a frontier spreads out breadth-first instead of diving down one bottomless path and getting stuck.
Pure DFS chasing all the way down runs straight into an infinite directory and burns the whole budget on that one path, never reaching other sites.
Random jumping with no queue guarantees neither breadth of coverage nor any control over crawl pace or priority.
Crawling only the seed domains' homepages misses the vast majority of the reachable web graph, at odds with the goal of expanding across the whole web.

scenario: 下载器并发很高，但同一 host 不能被瞬间打爆；每个站点之间还要留抓取间隔。
scenario_en: Downloaders are highly parallel, but the same host must not be flooded and needs delay between fetches.
q: frontier 怎么保证礼貌性？
q_en: How should the frontier enforce politeness?
options: 按 host 分 back queue
所有 URL 放一个全局 FIFO，worker 抢到就抓
只靠 robots.txt，不做队列隔离
随机 sleep，不区分目标站点
options_en: Use host-based back queues.
Put every URL in one global FIFO and let workers race.
Rely only on robots.txt without queue isolation.
Sleep randomly without separating target hosts.
why: 约束是同一 host 的请求要限速，所以按 host 分队列最稳。代价是调度更复杂，还要处理队列冷热不均。
why_en: Host-based back queues enforce per-site rate limits, at the cost of more scheduling and uneven queue load.
tradeoff: 站点保护 vs 调度复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果只是内网白名单小爬虫，单队列加全局限速可能已经够用。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  URL[New URL] --> Router[Host router]
  Router --> B1[back queue host A]
  Router --> B2[back queue host B]
  B1 --> W1[worker A]
  B2 --> W2[worker B]

termDefinitions.meaning: URL 里的站点主机名，例如 example.com。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A host is the site name in a URL, such as example.com.

termDefinitions.meaning: First In, First Out，先进先出的队列顺序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO means First In, First Out queue order.

termDefinitions.meaning: robots.txt 是站点发布给爬虫的路径允许和禁止规则文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: robots.txt is a site file that tells crawlers which paths are allowed or disallowed.

termDefinitions.meaning: back queue 是按 host 拆开的待抓队列，用来控制单站点抓取节奏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A back queue is a per-host crawl queue used to control per-site fetch rate.

optionExplanations: 约束是同一个 host 不能被瞬间打爆，按 host 分开各自的 back queue，才能真正把限速落到每个站点头上，而不是全局笼统限一个数。
所有 URL 挤进一个全局 FIFO，worker 抢到就抓，完全没法单独控制某一个 host 被打的频率。
只靠 robots.txt 说明能不能抓，它不负责控制抓取节奏，光靠它挡不住同一 host 被并发打爆。
不区分目标站点的随机 sleep，热门站点和冷门站点会被同样对待，起不到针对性保护热门 host 的作用。
optionExplanations_en: The constraint is that a single host can't get hammered all at once, so splitting a separate back queue per host is what actually pins the rate limit to each site individually, instead of one blunt global number.
Dumping every URL into one global FIFO where workers grab whatever's next gives no way to control how often any one specific host gets hit.
robots.txt only says what's allowed to be crawled — it says nothing about pacing, so it alone can't stop one host from being hit concurrently.
Random sleeps that don't distinguish target sites treat a hot host and a quiet one the same, failing to give the busier host the protection it actually needs.

scenario: 抓取预算有限；首页、热门站点和更新频繁页面，比低质量论坛旧帖更值得早抓。
scenario_en: Crawl budget is limited; home pages, popular sites, and frequently updated pages are more valuable than low-quality old posts.
q: frontier 怎么表达优先级？
q_en: How should the frontier express URL priority?
options: 打分后进 priority queue
严格按发现时间排序，完全 FIFO
随机打散 URL，不保留评分
用 LIFO 栈优先抓最新发现 URL
options_en: Score URLs and put them into a priority queue.
Use strict FIFO order by discovery time.
Randomly shuffle URLs without keeping scores.
Use a LIFO stack and fetch the newest discovered URL first.
why: 有限预算下，队列选择应该偏向更有价值或更容易变化的页面。代价是要维护评分信号，低分页面可能更晚被访问。
why_en: With limited crawl budget, the selector should bias toward valuable or fast-changing URLs, while accepting ranking complexity.
tradeoff: 抓取价值 vs 调度公平
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是完整归档一个小站，纯 FIFO 更简单也更公平。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用链接关系估计网页重要性的评分思想。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PageRank estimates page importance from link structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: priority queue 是按优先级而不是入队时间取元素的队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A priority queue pops items by priority rather than by insertion time.

termDefinitions.meaning: FIFO 是先进先出的队列顺序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO means First In, First Out queue order.

optionExplanations: 预算有限时，给每个 URL 打分再放进优先队列，能让首页、热门站点和常更新页面优先被抓，把预算花在更值的地方。
严格按发现时间的 FIFO 完全不考虑页面价值，一个刚发现的低质量旧帖会和高价值热门页面排在同样的位置。
随机打散且不保留评分，等于主动丢掉了本可以用来区分页面价值的信息，回到了盲抓状态。
LIFO 栈只偏爱最新发现的 URL，跟“首页和热门站点更值得早抓”这个真正的优先级依据完全对不上。
optionExplanations_en: With a limited crawl budget, scoring each URL and putting it into a priority queue lets homepages, popular sites, and frequently updated pages get crawled first, spending the budget where it counts.
Strict discovery-time FIFO ignores page value entirely — a just-found low-quality old forum post queues at the same level as a high-value popular page.
Randomly scattering URLs and discarding any scoring throws away exactly the information that could distinguish page value, back to crawling blind.
A LIFO stack only favors whatever was discovered most recently, which has nothing to do with the actual priority signal of homepages and popular sites deserving earlier crawls.

scenario: 几十亿 URL 会重复进入系统；你只需要大概率挡住重复 URL，少量误判可通过后续补抓接受。
scenario_en: Billions of URLs may re-enter the system; you mainly need to block duplicates, and rare false positives are acceptable.
q: URL Seen 用什么结构合适？
q_en: What is a good structure for URL Seen?
options: Bloom filter 加持久 URL 存储
内存 hash set 保存所有已见 URL
让数据库 unique index 承担所有在线去重
只靠下载日志离线 grep 重复 URL
options_en: Use a Bloom filter plus persistent URL records.
Keep every seen URL in an in-memory hash set.
Let a database unique index handle all online deduplication.
Rely only on offline grep over download logs.
why: URL 去重要挡的是重复入队和循环，Bloom filter 用很小内存换取快速判断。它会有误判，所以关键 URL 仍要有持久记录或补偿策略。
why_en: A Bloom filter cheaply blocks duplicate enqueue attempts, but persistent records are still needed because false positives can happen.
tradeoff: 内存效率 vs 误判风险
whenOtherWins: 如果规模很小且不能接受任何误判，普通 hash set 或数据库唯一约束更直观。

termDefinitions.meaning: Bloom filter 是省内存的概率集合，可能误判存在但不会漏掉已加入项。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a compact probabilistic set that may false-positive but will not miss inserted items.

termDefinitions.meaning: 误判为存在；这里可能导致某个新 URL 被跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive means a new URL may be treated as already seen.

termDefinitions.meaning: hash set 是用哈希表保存唯一元素的精确集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash set is an exact set backed by a hash table.

termDefinitions.meaning: unique index 是数据库保证字段不重复的索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A unique index enforces that a database key is not duplicated.

optionExplanations: 几十亿 URL 只要几 GB 位数组就能判重，误判方向只会多抓一次，不会漏掉真正的新链接。
内存 hash set 保存全部已见 URL，在几十亿这个规模下内存开销会大到不现实，跟题目给的规模不匹配。
让数据库唯一索引承担全部在线去重，意味着每次入队判断都要打一次数据库，在这个吞吐量级下会成为明显瓶颈。
只靠下载日志离线 grep 重复 URL 是事后分析，没法在 URL 真正入队之前就挡住重复，起不到在线去重的作用。
optionExplanations_en: A few gigabytes of bit array covers billions of URLs, and its false positives only cost one extra fetch — it never drops a genuinely new link.
An in-memory hash set holding every seen URL becomes unrealistically large at this billions-of-URLs scale, not matching the scale given here.
Having a database unique index own all online deduplication means hitting the database on every single enqueue check, which becomes an obvious bottleneck at this throughput.
Grepping download logs offline for duplicate URLs is after-the-fact analysis — it can't block a duplicate before it's actually enqueued, so it doesn't do online deduplication at all.

scenario: 不同 URL 可能返回几乎相同的 HTML；系统要避免把重复内容存 5 年。
scenario_en: Different URLs may return essentially the same HTML; the system should avoid storing duplicate content for five years.
q: 内容去重先比什么？
q_en: What should content dedup compare first?
options: HTML 内容指纹或 hash
URL canonicalization 后的规范化 URL
SimHash/MinHash 这类近似指纹
只比较 title 或 meta description
options_en: A content fingerprint or hash of the HTML.
The canonicalized URL after URL normalization.
An approximate fingerprint such as SimHash or MinHash.
Only the title or meta description.
why: 重复内容不一定有相同 URL，所以要对内容本身做指纹。hash 比逐字符和全量存储比较便宜得多。
why_en: Duplicate content can live at different URLs, so compare content fingerprints instead of URL strings.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是防止同一 URL 重复抓取，URL Seen 才是更早的过滤层。
tradeoff: 内容相等判断 vs 计算成本

termDefinitions.meaning: hash 把内容映射成固定长度指纹，便于快速比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash maps content to a fixed-size fingerprint for fast comparison.

termDefinitions.meaning: URL canonicalization 是把等价 URL 归一成同一种表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: URL canonicalization normalizes equivalent URLs into one representation.

termDefinitions.meaning: SimHash 是用于近似重复检测的局部敏感指纹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SimHash is a locality-sensitive fingerprint for near-duplicate detection.

termDefinitions.meaning: MinHash 用集合相似度近似估计内容是否相近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MinHash estimates set similarity to detect near-duplicate content.

optionExplanations: 不同 URL 完全可能返回几乎相同的内容，只有对页面内容本身算指纹或哈希，才能真正判断两份内容是不是重复。
URL 规范化处理的是同一资源的不同 URL 写法，解决不了“不同 URL、内容却相同”这个问题。
SimHash/MinHash 这类近似指纹适合判断“高度相似”，但这里要挡的是内容重复存储，先用简单指纹判断相等已经够用且更省算力。
只比较 title 或 meta description 会漏掉正文完全不同、标题恰好相似的页面，也会误判正文相同但标题不同的重复内容。
optionExplanations_en: Different URLs can absolutely return near-identical content, so only fingerprinting or hashing the content itself can actually tell whether two pieces of content are duplicates.
URL canonicalization handles different URL spellings of the same resource — it doesn't address "different URLs, same content."

Techniques like SimHash/MinHash are for judging "highly similar," but the goal here is blocking duplicate storage, where a simpler content fingerprint for exact equality is already enough and cheaper.
Comparing only title or meta description misses pages with completely different bodies but similar titles, and misidentifies pages with the same body but different titles as duplicates.

scenario: URL frontier 有数亿待抓 URL；全内存不可靠，全磁盘又会让 enqueue/dequeue 很慢。
scenario_en: The URL frontier has hundreds of millions of pending URLs; all-memory is not durable, and all-disk makes enqueue/dequeue slow.
q: frontier 存储怎么折中？
q_en: What storage compromise fits the frontier?
options: 磁盘保存主体，内存缓冲读写
全部放应用进程内存并定期快照
关系库表保存全部 URL，并按状态索引扫描
Kafka/log 保存入队事件，另建可消费状态表
options_en: Keep the main set on disk with memory buffers for reads and writes.
Keep everything in process memory with periodic snapshots.
Store all URLs in a relational table and scan by status index.
Store enqueue events in Kafka or a log and maintain a consumable state table.
why: 主体落盘解决容量和恢复，内存 buffer 降低频繁入队出队的 I/O。代价是崩溃恢复要处理 buffer 刷盘边界。
why_en: Disk provides capacity and recovery, while memory buffers reduce queue I/O on the hot path.
tradeoff: 持久容量 vs 队列吞吐
whenOtherWins: 如果 frontier 只有几万 URL，内存队列加快照更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: I/O 是程序和磁盘或网络之间的数据读写。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: I/O is data movement between a program and storage or network.

termDefinitions.meaning: frontier 是 crawler 中保存待抓 URL 并负责调度的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A frontier stores and schedules URLs waiting to be crawled.

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 是持久化追加日志式消息系统，常用于事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a durable append-log messaging system often used for event streams.

optionExplanations: 数亿待抓 URL 全存内存不可靠，全存磁盘每次入队出队都慢，把主体落在磁盘、用内存做读写缓冲，正好在容量和吞吐之间找到平衡。
全部放进应用进程内存并定期快照，进程一崩溃，两次快照之间的数据仍然会丢，可靠性达不到数亿级规模的要求。
关系库表存全部 URL 再按状态索引扫描，在这个规模下频繁的入队出队会让数据库承受远超它擅长的高频小事务压力。
用日志保存入队事件、另建状态表虽然可行，但比起磁盘+内存缓冲的直接方案，多引入了一套额外的组件和一致性维护成本。
optionExplanations_en: With hundreds of millions of pending URLs, keeping it all in memory isn't reliable and keeping it all on disk makes every enqueue/dequeue slow — putting the bulk on disk with an in-memory read/write buffer strikes the balance between capacity and throughput.

Keeping everything in the application process's memory with periodic snapshots still loses whatever changed since the last snapshot the moment the process crashes — not reliable enough at hundreds-of-millions scale.
A relational table holding every URL, scanned by a status index, forces the database to absorb far more high-frequency small transactions than it's built for at this scale.

Logging enqueue events into something like Kafka with a separately built consumable state table is workable, but adds a whole extra component and consistency burden compared to the direct disk-plus-buffer approach.

scenario: 下载线程经常要把域名解析成 IP；外部 DNS 查询可能 10-200ms，还会阻塞线程。
scenario_en: Downloader threads constantly resolve domains to IPs; external DNS calls may take 10-200 ms and block threads.
q: HTML 下载器先加什么优化？
q_en: What optimization should the HTML downloader add first?
options: 本地 DNS cache，定期刷新
每个 URL 都同步查公共 DNS
把 IP 写死在代码里
取消域名解析直接请求 URL
options_en: A local DNS cache refreshed periodically.
Synchronously query public DNS for every URL.
Hard-code IP addresses in code.
Skip resolution and request URLs directly.
why: DNS 查询在下载链路上很频繁，缓存域名到 IP 能少掉大量等待。代价是 TTL 到期和 IP 变化要靠后台刷新处理。
why_en: A local DNS cache removes repeated blocking lookups from the downloader hot path while requiring refresh logic.
tradeoff: 解析延迟 vs 地址新鲜度
whenOtherWins: 如果域名很少且变化强依赖权威 DNS，短 TTL 的实时查询更保守。

termDefinitions.meaning: Domain Name System，把域名解析成 IP 地址。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DNS maps domain names to IP addresses.

termDefinitions.meaning: Time To Live，缓存记录在过期前可复用的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a cached record may be reused.

optionExplanations: 域名解析这一步在下载链路上极其频繁，先把结果缓存在本地、定期刷新，能省掉大量原本要等待外部 DNS 响应的时间。
每个 URL 都同步查一次公共 DNS，等于把 10-200ms 这段延迟原样叠加到每次下载请求上，完全没有利用重复域名带来的省时机会。
把 IP 写死在代码里，域名一旦换 IP，这个爬虫就会持续连接失败，也没法应对正常的 DNS 变更。
取消域名解析直接请求 URL 在技术上根本行不通，HTTP 请求最终还是要知道目标服务器的 IP 地址。
optionExplanations_en: DNS lookups happen extremely often on the download path, so caching the result locally with periodic refreshes saves a large amount of time that would otherwise go into waiting on external DNS responses.
Synchronously querying public DNS for every single URL stacks that 10-200ms delay onto every download request, missing the obvious time savings from repeated domains.
Hardcoding IPs into the code means the crawler keeps failing to connect the moment a domain's IP changes, and it can't adapt to normal DNS updates at all.
Skipping domain resolution and hitting the URL directly isn't technically workable at all — an HTTP request still needs to know the target server's IP address eventually.

scenario: 你的爬虫准备访问一个新站点；站点可能声明哪些路径不允许被某些 crawler 抓取。
scenario_en: Your crawler is about to visit a new site; the site may declare which paths a crawler should not fetch.
q: 抓取前要先处理什么？
q_en: What should be handled before crawling?
options: 读取并缓存 robots.txt 规则
立刻就对整站发起大规模并发抓取请求
只看页面 title
先把所有链接写入索引
options_en: Fetch and cache robots.txt rules.
Immediately launch massive parallel crawling of the whole site
Only inspect the page title.
Write all links to the index first.
why: robots.txt 是站点给 crawler 的访问规则，先读它能避免抓禁区。缓存可以少重复下载，但要定期刷新。
why_en: Read robots.txt before crawling a site so the crawler respects disallowed paths without refetching the file every time.
whenOtherWins: 如果站点是你自有服务且另有白名单协议，也可以用内部策略替代 robots.txt。

termDefinitions.meaning: Robots Exclusion Protocol 的常见文件名，用来声明 crawler 可抓和不可抓路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: robots.txt is the common Robots Exclusion Protocol file that tells crawlers which paths are allowed.

optionExplanations: 每个 host 只拉一次规则并按 TTL 复用，抓取前查内存里的允许列表，几乎不增加延迟。
不看 robots.txt 就直接全站并发抓取，很可能碰上站点明确禁止抓取的路径，既不合规也可能触发站点的防护措施。
只看页面 title 跟“这个路径允不允许被抓”这个前置判断完全不是一回事。
抓取之前先写索引会把还没确认允许抓取的内容也纳入索引，顺序完全反了。
optionExplanations_en: Fetch the rules once per host and reuse them under a TTL, checking the in-memory allow list before each fetch so latency barely moves.
Crawling a whole site concurrently without checking robots.txt first is likely to hit paths the site explicitly forbids, both non-compliant and likely to trigger the site's own protections.
Looking only at a page's title has nothing to do with the prior question of whether this path is even allowed to be crawled.
Writing to the index before crawling would index content that was never even confirmed as crawlable — the order here is completely backwards.

scenario: 下载后的 HTML 可能畸形、超大或带恶意结构；下载线程必须保持吞吐。
scenario_en: Downloaded HTML may be malformed, huge, or maliciously structured; downloader threads must keep throughput high.
q: 解析器为什么拆成独立组件？
q_en: Why split parsing into a separate component?
options: 隔离慢解析和坏页面，避免拖住下载链路
让 DNS 解析更准确
替代 URL frontier
减少 robots.txt 文件大小
options_en: To isolate slow parsing and bad pages from the download path.
To make DNS resolution more accurate.
To replace the URL frontier.
To reduce robots.txt size.
why: 解析是 CPU 和异常风险更高的阶段，拆出去能让下载器继续拉取页面。代价是多一次组件间传递和队列。
why_en: Parsing is CPU-heavy and failure-prone, so isolating it keeps downloaders focused on network throughput.
tradeoff: 下载吞吐 vs 管线复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果只是小规模脚本，下载后进程内解析更省事。

termDefinitions.meaning: HyperText Markup Language，网页结构标记语言。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTML is the markup language used to structure web pages.

optionExplanations: 畸形或超大 HTML、恶意结构都可能拖慢甚至搞崩解析这一步，把它拆成独立组件，能让下载线程不受影响地继续拉取下一批页面。
解析器处理的是 HTML 内容，跟 DNS 域名解析这个更早的步骤没有直接关系，不会让 DNS 更准确。
解析器负责从内容里抽取信息，frontier 负责调度待抓 URL，两者职责不同，解析器替代不了 frontier。
robots.txt 文件本身的大小由站点决定，跟下载后解析 HTML 是不是独立组件毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: Malformed or oversized HTML and malicious structures can all slow down or even crash the parsing step, so pulling it into its own component keeps download threads free to keep pulling the next batch of pages regardless.
The parser handles HTML content — it has no direct connection to DNS resolution, an earlier and unrelated step, so it doesn't make DNS more accurate.
The parser extracts information from content while the frontier schedules pending URLs — different responsibilities, so the parser can't substitute for the frontier.
The size of a robots.txt file is decided by the site itself, unrelated to whether HTML parsing happens as an independent component after download.

scenario: 一个页面下载成功后，系统要决定是否存内容、是否抽取链接、以及哪些新 URL 进入待抓队列。
scenario_en: After a page is downloaded, the system must decide whether to store content, extract links, and enqueue new URLs.
q: 页面进入系统后的处理顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the processing order after a page enters the system?
steps: 过滤抽出的 URL，并检查 URL Seen
解析和校验 HTML
内容指纹查重，重复则丢弃
抽取链接并转成绝对 URL
新 URL 写入 frontier
why: 先保证页面可解析，再用内容去重避免重复存储；只有新内容才值得抽链接。最后再用 URL 去重保护 frontier。
why_en: Validate the page, dedupe the content, extract links, filter and dedupe URLs, then enqueue only new crawl targets.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Downloaded HTML] --> B[Parse and validate]
  B --> C[Content hash seen?]
  C -->|new| D[Extract links]
  D --> E[Filter URLs]
  E --> F[URL seen?]
  F -->|new| G[URL frontier]

termDefinitions.meaning: 包含协议和域名的完整 URL，便于后续下载器直接访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An absolute URL includes scheme and host so a downloader can fetch it directly.

scenario: 大规模爬虫会遇到坏 HTML、慢站点、服务器扩缩容和进程崩溃。
scenario_en: A large crawler sees malformed HTML, slow sites, server scaling events, and process crashes.
q: 哪些措施主要提升鲁棒性？
q_en: Which measures mainly improve robustness?
options: 保存 crawl state，失败后可恢复
异常处理和数据校验
consistent hashing 分散下载器负载
把所有页面永久放内存
options_en: Persist crawl state so failures can recover.
Use exception handling and data validation.
Use consistent hashing to spread downloader load.
Keep every page permanently in memory.
why: 恢复状态、校验输入和稳定分配负载，都是让系统在坏数据和节点变化下继续跑。全内存只会放大故障损失。
why_en: Persisted state, validation, and stable load distribution keep the crawler running through bad inputs and node changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性哈希让节点增删时只迁移少量 key，常用于分摊负载。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing moves only a small portion of keys when nodes are added or removed.

optionExplanations: 对，保存抓取状态能让进程崩溃后从断点恢复，而不是从零开始重新抓一遍。
对，异常处理和数据校验能防止一个坏页面或畸形数据把整条流水线带崩。
对，一致性哈希能让下载器集群扩缩容时只迁移一小部分负载，机器增删不会引发大规模重新分配。
把所有页面永久放内存不但装不下 PB 级数据，进程一崩溃反而会让损失被放大，跟提升鲁棒性的方向正好相反。
optionExplanations_en: Right — saving crawl state lets the process resume from where it left off after a crash instead of starting over from scratch.
Right — exception handling and data validation stop one bad page or malformed data from taking down the whole pipeline.
Right — consistent hashing means the download-cluster scaling in or out only reshuffles a small slice of load, instead of triggering mass reassignment on every machine change.
Keeping every page permanently in memory can't hold petabyte-scale data and actually magnifies the damage the moment a process crashes — the opposite of improving robustness.

scenario: 已抓页面会新增、修改和删除；但全量重抓几十亿 URL 会浪费下载预算。
scenario_en: Crawled pages can be added, edited, or deleted, but recrawling billions of URLs wastes crawl budget.
q: 怎么安排 freshness？
q_en: How should freshness be scheduled?
options: 按历史更新频率和重要性调度重抓
每天全量重抓所有 URL
永不重抓已见 URL
只重抓 URL 最短的页面
options_en: Schedule recrawls by update history and importance.
Recrawl every URL every day.
Never recrawl seen URLs.
Recrawl only the shortest URLs.
why: freshness 的约束是预算有限，所以高价值、常变化页面要更频繁。代价是要记录历史信号，低价值页面会更旧。
why_en: Freshness should spend crawl budget on important or frequently changing pages instead of recrawling everything equally.
tradeoff: 内容新鲜度 vs 抓取成本
whenOtherWins: 如果是合规归档且规模很小，固定周期全量重抓更容易解释。

termDefinitions.meaning: 索引内容接近真实网页当前状态的程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freshness is how closely indexed content matches the current web state.

optionExplanations: 预算有限，按历史更新频率和重要性来安排重抓节奏，能把有限的抓取次数优先花在真正会变化、也真正值得关注的页面上。
几十亿 URL 每天全量重抓会把抓取预算消耗在大量根本不会变化的页面上，是明显的浪费。
永不重抓已见 URL 意味着页面即便更新了，系统也永远拿不到最新内容，跟“已抓页面会新增修改删除”这个前提矛盾。
URL 长度和页面本身是否需要重抓没有任何关联，用它做重抓依据没有意义。
optionExplanations_en: With a limited budget, scheduling recrawls by historical change frequency and importance spends the limited crawl budget where content actually changes and actually matters.
Fully recrawling billions of URLs every day burns the crawl budget on a huge number of pages that never change at all — an obvious waste.
Never recrawling a seen URL means the system can never pick up updates even though pages do get added, modified, and deleted — contradicting the premise itself.
URL length has no bearing on whether a page actually needs recrawling — using it as the basis makes no sense.

scenario: 某站点不断生成 /foo/bar/foo/bar/... 这类越来越深的 URL，队列数量异常增长。
scenario_en: A site keeps generating deeper URLs such as /foo/bar/foo/bar/..., and its queue count grows abnormally.
q: 先怎么防 spider trap？
q_en: How should you first guard against a spider trap?
options: 限制 URL 长度/深度，并对异常站点加定制过滤
提高该站点优先级
关闭 URL Seen
把该站点的所有 URL 路径都保存整整 5 年
options_en: Limit URL length or depth and add custom filters for abnormal sites.
Raise that site's priority.
Disable URL Seen.
Store every URL path from that site for five years
why: 无限路径会吃掉 frontier 和下载预算，先用长度/深度挡住明显陷阱。没有万能自动识别法，异常站点常要人工确认后加规则。
why_en: Spider traps consume the frontier, so cap obvious path growth and add site-specific filters after confirming abnormal behavior.
whenOtherWins: 如果这个深路径是业务必须抓的合法目录，要用白名单放行并单独限速。

termDefinitions.meaning: 会让 crawler 陷入无限或近似无限链接空间的页面模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A spider trap is a page pattern that sends a crawler into an infinite or near-infinite link space.

optionExplanations: 路径深度会无限增长正是陷阱的特征，先限制 URL 长度或深度，再对确认异常的站点加定制过滤规则，能把这类陷阱挡在明显扩散之前。
提高这个站点的抓取优先级只会让爬虫更快地把预算耗尽在这个陷阱上，跟想解决的问题方向相反。
关闭 URL Seen 只会让重复 URL 也一起漏过去重检查，不但没挡住陷阱，反而制造了更多重复抓取。
陷阱本身产生的是没有真实价值的重复路径，把这些路径都存 5 年只是在白白浪费存储。
optionExplanations_en: Path depth growing without bound is exactly the signature of a trap, so capping URL length or depth first, then adding custom filtering for sites confirmed abnormal, catches these traps before the damage spreads.
Raising this site's crawl priority only burns the budget on the trap even faster, the opposite direction from what's needed.
Turning off URL Seen lets ordinary duplicate URLs slip through the dedup check too — it doesn't block the trap and actually creates more duplicate crawling instead.
A trap generates worthless repetitive paths with no real value — storing all of them for 5 years is just wasting storage for nothing.

scenario: 很多网页靠 JavaScript 运行后才生成链接；直接下载原始 HTML 时看不到这些链接。
scenario_en: Many pages generate links only after JavaScript runs; raw HTML downloads do not reveal those links.
q: 要补哪条能力？
q_en: What capability should be added?
options: 动态渲染后再解析链接
只增加 DNS cache
只扩大 Bloom filter
禁止抓取含脚本页面
options_en: Render dynamically before parsing links.
Only add a DNS cache.
Only enlarge the Bloom filter.
Ban pages that contain scripts.
why: 问题不在下载速度，而在链接要运行脚本后才出现。渲染成本高，所以通常只给需要它的页面走这条路径。
why_en: If links appear only after JavaScript runs, render the page before extraction, but reserve that costly path for pages that need it.
tradeoff: 链接完整性 vs 渲染成本
whenOtherWins: 如果目标站点主要是静态 HTML，直接解析更便宜。

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器执行的脚本语言，常用来动态生成页面内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: JavaScript is a browser-executed language often used to generate page content dynamically.

optionExplanations: 链接是脚本运行后才生成的，直接下载原始 HTML 根本看不到它们，只有先做动态渲染、拿到渲染后的 DOM 再抽链才能补上这些链接。
增加 DNS cache 优化的是域名解析速度，跟脚本运行后才出现的链接完全不是一回事，解决不了看不到链接的问题。
扩大 Bloom filter 只是提高去重容量，跟这些链接压根没被抓取到没有任何关系。
禁止抓取含脚本页面会直接放弃这批页面上的所有链接和内容，跟“要补上这些链接”的目标完全相反。
optionExplanations_en: The links only exist after a script runs, so downloading raw HTML never sees them — only rendering the page first, getting the resulting DOM, and then extracting links can recover them.
Adding a DNS cache speeds up domain resolution, an unrelated concern from links that only appear after script execution — it doesn't fix the missing-link problem at all.
Enlarging the Bloom filter just raises dedup capacity, unrelated to the fact these links were never even captured in the first place.
Refusing to crawl pages with scripts just gives up on every link and piece of content on those pages entirely — the opposite of the goal of recovering those links.

scenario: 你要启动全网搜索爬虫，手里不能只有一个首页；希望尽快覆盖不同地区和主题。
scenario_en: You are bootstrapping a web-scale crawler and cannot start from a single homepage; you want early coverage across regions and topics.
q: seed URL 怎么选更稳？
q_en: How should seed URLs be chosen?
options: 只选一个最热门的网站首页作为唯一种子
按地区和主题分桶，各桶放高质量入口
随机生成域名直到能访问
只从广告链接开始
options_en: Pick one very popular home page as the sole seed
Bucket by region and topic, with high-quality entry URLs per bucket.
Generate random domains until they work.
Start only from advertisement links.
why: 种子 URL 决定早期覆盖面，按地区和主题分桶能减少偏向单一站点。代价是维护入口清单和质量评分。
why_en: Seed URLs shape early coverage, so bucket them by region and topic instead of relying on one starting point.
tradeoff: 覆盖多样性 vs 种子维护成本
whenOtherWins: 如果只抓一个公司站点，根域名和 sitemap 就是更简单的种子。

termDefinitions.meaning: 爬虫开始遍历时放入 frontier 的初始 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A seed URL is an initial URL placed into the crawl frontier.

optionExplanations: 希望尽快覆盖不同地区和主题，按这两个维度分桶、每个桶放高质量入口，能让早期抓取从一开始就铺得更广，不会一头扎进单一站点。
只选一个最热门网站首页，早期覆盖会严重偏向这一个站点及其关联页面，跟“覆盖不同地区和主题”的目标背道而驰。
随机生成域名直到能访问，命中的多半是无关或低质量站点，起不到有意规划覆盖面的作用。
只从广告链接开始，覆盖面会被带偏到广告网络关联的站点，跟真正想覆盖的多元内容不匹配。
optionExplanations_en: Wanting to cover different regions and topics quickly, bucketing seed URLs by those two dimensions and stocking each bucket with high-quality entry points lets early crawling spread out from the start instead of tunneling into one site.
Picking just one hot site's homepage skews early coverage heavily toward that one site and its linked pages, working against the goal of covering different regions and topics.
Randomly generating domains until one responds mostly lands on irrelevant or low-quality sites, providing no deliberate control over coverage at all.
Starting only from ad links skews coverage toward whatever sites the ad network happens to link to, mismatched with the actually intended diverse coverage.

scenario: 你只需要抓某大学站点，不做全网索引；目标是覆盖该域名下的公开页面。
scenario_en: You only need to crawl one university site, not the whole web; the goal is public pages under that domain.
q: 这种范围下 seed 该怎么简化？
q_en: How can seeds be simplified for this scope?
options: 使用大学根域名和 sitemap 作为入口
继续按全球国家分桶
从随机抓来的一大批社交媒体链接开始往下爬
只抓外链最多的商业站点
options_en: Use the university root domain and sitemap as entries.
Still bucket by every country worldwide.
Start from a random batch of social-media links
Crawl the commercial site with the most backlinks.
why: 范围变成单站点时，根域名和 sitemap 已经给出高质量入口。全网分桶会增加无关抓取。
why_en: For a single-domain crawl, the root domain and sitemap give focused high-quality entry points.
tradeoff: 范围聚焦 vs 全网覆盖
whenOtherWins: 如果目标回到全网索引，单域名 seed 会严重偏窄。

termDefinitions.meaning: 网站提供的 URL 清单，帮助搜索引擎发现可抓页面。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sitemap is a site-provided URL list that helps crawlers discover pages.

optionExplanations: 范围已经收窄到一个大学站点，这个域名的根域名和 sitemap 本身就是高质量入口，直接用它们做种子就够了，不需要更复杂的机制。
继续按全球国家分桶是为全网索引设计的机制，用在单站点抓取上完全是过度设计，还会引入大量无关抓取。
从随机社交媒体链接开始跟这个大学站点毫无关系，起不到覆盖该域名下页面的作用。
只抓外链最多的商业站点，跟目标是覆盖这一个大学域名下公开页面的范围完全对不上。
optionExplanations_en: With the scope narrowed to one university site, that domain's root and sitemap are already a high-quality entry point on their own — using them directly is enough, no need for anything more elaborate.
Continuing to bucket by country is machinery built for full-web indexing — applying it to a single-site crawl is overkill and pulls in a lot of irrelevant crawling.
Starting from random social media links has nothing to do with this university site and does nothing to cover pages under its domain.
Crawling only the commercial sites with the most inbound links is completely mismatched with the actual goal of covering public pages under this one university domain.

scenario: 同一页面可能出现 http/https、大小写、尾斜杠、跟踪参数等多个 URL 形式。
scenario_en: The same page may appear with http/https, casing, trailing slash, or tracking parameters.
q: URL Seen 前应先做什么？
q_en: What should happen before URL Seen?
options: 直接把原始字符串入库
先做规范化，再查重
只比较页面标题
只保留 query string
options_en: Store the raw string directly.
Canonicalize first, then dedupe.
Compare only page titles.
Keep only the query string.
why: 不规范化会让同一资源绕过去重，造成重复抓取。代价是规则要小心，不能误删有业务含义的参数。
why_en: Canonicalization prevents duplicate crawl work caused by different URL spellings for the same resource.
tradeoff: 去重效果 vs 误合并风险
whenOtherWins: 如果站点明确把参数作为核心内容标识，规范化规则要按站点定制。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把等价 URL 转成统一形式，便于比较和去重。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Canonicalization converts equivalent URLs into one normalized form for comparison.

optionExplanations: 同一个页面可能有好几种 URL 写法，先把它们规范化成统一形式再去查重，才能真正认出这些其实是同一个资源。
直接把原始字符串入库，http/https、大小写、尾斜杠、跟踪参数这些差异会让同一资源被当成好几个不同 URL，重复抓取好几次。
只比较页面标题跟判断两个 URL 是不是同一资源没有直接关系，标题相同也可能是完全不同的页面。
只保留 query string 会把 URL 里真正标识资源路径的部分直接丢掉，规范化的方向错了。
optionExplanations_en: The same page can show up as several different URL spellings, so normalizing them into one canonical form before deduping is what actually recognizes they're the same resource.

Putting the raw string straight into storage lets differences in http/https, casing, trailing slashes, and tracking parameters make the same resource look like several different URLs, getting crawled multiple times.
Comparing only page titles has no direct bearing on whether two URLs are the same resource — identical titles can still belong to completely different pages.
Keeping only the query string throws away the part of the URL that actually identifies the resource path — the wrong direction for normalization.

scenario: HTML 里抽出的链接常是 /wiki/A 这类相对路径；下载器后续需要完整地址。
scenario_en: Links extracted from HTML are often relative paths such as /wiki/A; the downloader later needs full addresses.
q: link extractor 还要做哪步？
q_en: What else should the link extractor do?
options: 把相对 URL 转成绝对 URL
把所有链接改成同一个 host
删除协议和域名
把 HTML 存进 DNS cache
options_en: Convert relative URLs to absolute URLs.
Rewrite all links to the same host.
Remove scheme and domain.
Store HTML in the DNS cache.
why: frontier 需要可直接下载的地址，所以相对路径要结合当前页面 base URL 补全。否则后续组件不知道目标 host。
why_en: The frontier needs fetchable URLs, so relative links must be resolved against the current page base URL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不包含完整协议和主机名、依赖当前页面上下文解释的 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A relative URL lacks full scheme and host and must be resolved against the current page.

optionExplanations: 对，抽出来的相对路径要结合当前页面的 base URL 补全成完整地址，下载器后续才知道该往哪个 host 发请求。
把所有链接都改成同一个 host 会丢掉原本指向不同站点的真实目标，破坏了链接本来的去向。
删除协议和域名会让下载器彻底不知道该往哪台服务器发请求，方向完全反了。
HTML 内容和 DNS cache 是两个不同的东西，把 HTML 存进 DNS cache 在技术上也讲不通。
optionExplanations_en: Right — an extracted relative path needs completing against the current page's base URL into a full address, so the downloader later knows exactly which host to send the request to.
Turning every link into the same host throws away the real targets that originally pointed at different sites, breaking where the links were actually meant to go.
Stripping the protocol and domain leaves the downloader with no idea which server to even send the request to — exactly the wrong direction.
HTML content and a DNS cache are two different things — storing HTML inside a DNS cache doesn't even make technical sense.

scenario: 爬虫只收 HTML；PDF、图片、错误链接和黑名单站点都不该进入下载队列。
scenario_en: The crawler only collects HTML; PDFs, images, broken links, and blacklisted sites should not enter the download queue.
q: URL filter 放在哪更合适？
q_en: Where should the URL filter sit?
options: 下载前，在抽链后、URL Seen 前过滤
内容存储五年后再过滤
等 DNS 解析完成之后只对 IP 做过滤
完全交给浏览器渲染器
options_en: Before download, after extraction and before URL Seen.
Filter only after five years in content storage.
Filter only IPs after DNS resolution
Leave it entirely to the browser renderer.
why: 越早过滤，越少污染 frontier 和 URL Seen。把垃圾 URL 先入队会浪费下载器和去重存储。
why_en: Filter unwanted URLs before enqueueing so the frontier and dedupe store stay clean.
whenOtherWins: 如果过滤规则依赖下载后的内容特征，就要在 parser 后再做第二层内容过滤。

termDefinitions.meaning: 明确禁止访问或处理的站点、路径或模式集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blacklist is a set of sites, paths, or patterns that should be blocked.

tradeoff: 早过滤节省资源 vs 规则误杀风险
optionExplanations: 抽链之后、入队之前这一步最便宜：此时还没占用下载带宽，也没写进去重结构。
等内容都存了 5 年之后再过滤，垃圾内容早就已经占用了大量下载和存储资源，属于亡羊补牢。
DNS 解析完成后只过滤 IP，这时候已经完成了下载前最耗时的一步，太晚了，起不到提前拦截的作用。
完全交给浏览器渲染器意味着这些不该抓的内容还是会被真正下载和渲染一遍，没有提前挡住。
optionExplanations_en: Right after link extraction and before enqueueing is the cheapest point: nothing has consumed download bandwidth or entered the dedupe structure yet.
Filtering only after content has already been stored for 5 years means the junk already consumed huge amounts of download and storage resources — closing the barn door after the fact.
Filtering by IP only after DNS resolution completes has already spent the most time-consuming pre-download step — too late to intercept anything early.
Leaving it entirely to the browser renderer still means this unwanted content gets fully downloaded and rendered once — it never gets blocked ahead of time.

scenario: 同一站点 robots.txt 允许抓取，但站点也要求 crawler 不要短时间连续请求。
scenario_en: A site allows crawling in robots.txt but still expects crawlers not to send rapid repeated requests.
q: robots 和 rate limit 的关系是什么？
q_en: How do robots and rate limiting relate?
options: robots 说明可抓范围，rate limit 控制抓取节奏
robots 能自动限制每秒连接数
rate limit 可以直接忽略 robots 里禁止的路径
二者都只用于内容去重
options_en: robots defines allowed scope, while rate limiting controls pacing.
robots automatically limits connections per second.
Rate limiting can ignore disallowed robots paths
Both are only for content deduplication.
why: robots 解决能不能抓，礼貌限速解决抓多快。两者都要有，少一个都会伤害站点或合规性。
why_en: robots controls permission, while rate limiting controls pace; a polite crawler needs both.
whenOtherWins: 如果站点通过 Crawl-delay 明确给出节奏，可以把该值并入 per-host rate limit。

termDefinitions.meaning: 某些 robots 规则里声明的请求间隔提示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Crawl-delay is a robots directive hinting how long a crawler should wait between requests.

tradeoff: 抓取权限边界 vs 请求节奏控制
optionExplanations: robots 划定了哪些路径能不能碰，节奏限速控制的是能碰的路径要多快去访问，两者管的是完全不同的两件事，缺一个都不完整。
robots.txt 只是站点单方面声明的规则文本，它本身不会替爬虫自动执行每秒连接数的限制，那是爬虫自己要实现的。
忽略 robots 明确禁止的路径本身就是不合规行为，节奏限速再温和也不能作为绕开这一点的理由。
robots 管的是抓取范围，rate limit 管的是抓取节奏，两者都跟“内容去重”是不同的问题。
optionExplanations_en: robots defines which paths can and can't be touched, while rate limiting controls how fast the allowed ones get hit — two entirely different concerns, and skipping either leaves the picture incomplete.

robots.txt is just a text of rules the site declares unilaterally — it doesn't automatically enforce a per-second connection limit on the crawler itself; that's something the crawler has to implement.
Ignoring paths robots explicitly forbids is itself non-compliant — however gentle the rate limiting is, it's no excuse to bypass that.
robots governs crawl scope while rate limiting governs crawl pace — neither one is actually about content deduplication.

scenario: DNS cache 里的 IP 过旧，某域名已经迁移；下载器持续连接失败。
scenario_en: The DNS cache has a stale IP after a domain moved, and downloaders keep failing to connect.
q: DNS cache 需要什么保护？
q_en: What guard does a DNS cache need?
options: TTL 过期刷新，并在连接失败时触发重新解析
永远不刷新缓存
解析失败时把这个 URL 直接标记成重复内容
把所有域名解析到同一 IP
options_en: Refresh on TTL expiry and re-resolve on connection failures.
Never refresh cached records.
Mark the URL as duplicate content on failure
Resolve every domain to the same IP.
why: DNS cache 是性能优化，不是永久真相。TTL 和失败重解析能在速度和正确性之间折中。
why_en: A DNS cache is an optimization, so TTL and failure-triggered refresh balance speed with correctness.
tradeoff: 解析速度 vs 地址正确性
whenOtherWins: 如果域名极少且变化频繁，可以缩短 TTL，接受更多 DNS 查询。

termDefinitions.meaning: Internet Protocol 地址，网络中定位主机的地址。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An IP address identifies a host on a network.

optionExplanations: 缓存不是永久真相，TTL 到期主动刷新，加上连接失败时触发重新解析，能在正常情况下省时间、在域名真的迁移时也能纠正过来。
永远不刷新缓存意味着域名一旦迁移，下载器会持续用旧 IP 连接失败，永远等不来纠正的机会。
连接失败和内容是否重复是两个不相关的问题，把失败的 URL 标记成重复内容会污染正常的内容去重判断。
把所有域名解析到同一 IP 在技术上根本不成立，不同域名指向的是完全不同的服务器。
optionExplanations_en: A cache isn't the permanent truth, so refreshing when the TTL expires plus triggering a fresh lookup on connection failure saves time in the normal case while still self-correcting once a domain has genuinely moved.
Never refreshing the cache means once a domain migrates, the downloader keeps failing to connect against the stale IP with no way to ever correct itself.
Connection failure and content duplication are unrelated problems — marking a failed URL as duplicate content pollutes the actual content-dedup judgment.
Resolving every domain to the same IP doesn't even make technical sense — different domains point at entirely different servers.

scenario: 单机下载器达不到峰值吞吐；URL 空间很大，机器也要能横向增加。
scenario_en: One downloader machine cannot meet peak throughput; the URL space is huge and machines must be added horizontally.
q: 分布式 crawler 怎么分工？
q_en: How should a distributed crawler divide work?
options: 按 URL/host 分片，把不同分片交给不同下载器
所有机器重复抓同一批 URL
只扩数据库，不扩下载器
让每一台机器都随机抢占全网 URL 且完全不去重
options_en: Shard by URL or host and assign shards to downloaders.
Make every machine crawl the same URLs repeatedly.
Scale only the database, not downloaders.
Let every machine randomly grab web URLs with no dedupe at all
why: 分片让下载任务可水平扩展，也减少重复抓取。代价是分片迁移和热点 host 需要额外均衡。
why_en: Sharding the URL space lets download work scale horizontally while reducing duplicate effort.
tradeoff: 水平扩展 vs 分片均衡成本
whenOtherWins: 小型一次性爬虫可以先用单机队列，避免分布式协调。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据或任务按规则切成多个分区，每个分区由不同节点处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shard is a partition of data or work handled by a subset of nodes.

optionExplanations: 按 URL 或 host 把任务分片，交给不同下载器各自负责一部分，既能水平扩容，也天然避免了不同机器重复抓同一批 URL。
所有机器重复抓同一批 URL 完全没有利用多机器带来的额外吞吐，反而是纯粹的资源浪费。
只扩数据库不扩下载器解决不了下载吞吐这个瓶颈，下载本身才是这里要突破的容量上限。
每台机器随机抢全网且不去重，会让同一个 URL 被多台机器重复抓取，既浪费带宽也污染统计。
optionExplanations_en: Sharding tasks by URL or host and handing different pieces to different downloaders both scales out horizontally and naturally avoids different machines redundantly crawling the same URLs.
Having every machine crawl the same batch of URLs redundantly gets no extra throughput from the added machines at all — pure resource waste.
Scaling only the database while leaving the downloaders alone doesn't fix the download throughput bottleneck, which is exactly the ceiling that needs breaking here.
Letting every machine grab from the whole web randomly with no dedup lets the same URL get crawled by multiple machines redundantly, wasting bandwidth and polluting statistics.

scenario: 下载器集群经常增删机器；你不希望每次扩容都重新分配几乎所有 host。
scenario_en: Downloader machines are added and removed often; you do not want nearly every host reassigned on each change.
q: host 到下载器的映射用什么？
q_en: What should map hosts to downloaders?
options: consistent hashing
按当前的秒数对下载器机器台数取模
手写固定机器列表
随机数每次重算
options_en: Consistent hashing.
Modulo the current second by the machine count
A hard-coded machine list.
Recompute random assignment every time.
why: 一致性哈希让节点变化时只迁移相邻一小段 key，扩缩容更平滑。代价是还要处理虚拟节点和热点。
why_en: Consistent hashing limits remapping when downloader nodes change, which makes scaling smoother.
whenOtherWins: 如果节点集合固定且很小，简单 hash modulo 也够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性哈希把节点和 key 放到环上，节点变化时只影响部分 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing places nodes and keys on a ring so membership changes move only part of the keys.

tradeoff: 按 host 固定调度 vs 全局负载均衡灵活性
optionExplanations: 一致性哈希让机器增删时只影响相邻的一小段 host，不用每次扩容都把几乎所有 host 重新分配一遍。
按当前秒数取模，映射关系会随时间不断变化，同一个 host 下一秒可能就被分配到完全不同的机器上，起不到稳定映射的作用。
手写固定机器列表在集群经常增删的场景下需要频繁手动维护，完全没有自动适应扩缩容的能力。
随机数每次重算意味着同一个 host 每次映射结果都不一样，既不稳定也没法预测该去哪台机器。
optionExplanations_en: Consistent hashing means node changes only touch a small neighboring stretch of hosts, instead of remapping nearly every host every time the cluster scales.
Taking the modulo of the current second keeps changing the mapping constantly, so the same host could land on a completely different machine the next second — no stable mapping at all.
Hardcoding a fixed machine list needs constant manual upkeep in a cluster that frequently scales, with no ability to auto-adapt to scaling at all.
Recomputing a random number every time means the same host maps somewhere different each time — neither stable nor predictable about which machine to go to.

scenario: 下载某 URL 时服务器超时；这个 URL 可能稍后恢复，但一直重试会占满 worker。
scenario_en: Fetching a URL times out; it may recover later, but retrying forever can occupy workers.
q: 失败重试怎么设计？
q_en: How should fetch retry be designed?
options: 有限次数加 backoff，失败状态持久化后以后再调度
在一个无限的 tight loop 里立刻不停重试
立即把 host 永久拉黑
丢弃所有同域名 URL
options_en: Use bounded retries with backoff, persist failure state, and reschedule later.
Retry immediately in an infinite tight loop
Immediately blacklist the host forever.
Drop every URL from the same domain.
why: 短超时保护 worker，backoff 避免打爆慢站点。持久化失败状态能让系统恢复后继续处理。
why_en: Bounded backoff protects workers and slow sites while persistent failure state allows later recovery.
whenOtherWins: 如果明确是 404 这类永久失败，可以直接记录终态，不必重试。

termDefinitions.meaning: 失败后逐步拉长重试间隔，避免持续压垮下游。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backoff increases retry delay after failures to avoid hammering a dependency.

optionExplanations: 有限次数加退避，能给站点恢复留出时间，把失败状态持久化下来，系统重启或恢复后还能接着按计划再调度这个 URL。
无限 tight loop 重试会持续占满 worker 资源，一个慢站点就能拖垮整个下载器集群的可用容量。
立即把整个 host 永久拉黑，会因为一次可能是临时性的超时，永久放弃这个站点上所有其他本来能正常抓到的页面。
丢弃所有同域名 URL 跟一次单独的超时失败完全不成比例，会连带损失大量本可以正常抓取的内容。
optionExplanations_en: A bounded retry count with backoff gives the site time to recover, and persisting the failure state means the system can pick this URL back up on schedule after a restart or recovery.
An unbounded tight retry loop keeps saturating worker capacity — one slow site alone could drag down the entire downloader cluster's available capacity.
Immediately blacklisting the whole host permanently, over what might be just a temporary timeout, gives up on every other otherwise-fine page on that site forever.
Dropping every URL on the same domain is wildly disproportionate to a single isolated timeout failure, losing a large amount of content that could otherwise crawl fine.

scenario: HTML 原文有 PB 级，少量热门页面会频繁被解析或查询。
scenario_en: Raw HTML is PB-scale, while a small set of popular pages is frequently parsed or queried.
q: 内容存储怎么选？
q_en: How should content storage be shaped?
options: 大部分落盘/对象存储，热门内容进内存缓存
全部进内存
把所有抓回来的内容全部塞进 DNS cache 里
只存 URL 不存内容
options_en: Store most content on disk/object storage and cache hot content in memory.
Put everything in memory.
Stuff everything into the DNS cache
Store only URLs and no content.
why: PB 级内容必须依赖便宜持久存储，内存只服务热点。这样成本可控，但冷数据读取会慢一些。
why_en: PB-scale content belongs on durable storage, with memory reserved for hot pages.
tradeoff: 存储成本 vs 热点延迟
whenOtherWins: 如果系统只做实时监控不保留原文，内容存储可以更短 TTL。

termDefinitions.meaning: 面向大对象的持久存储，常用于图片、HTML 快照和备份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Object storage is durable storage for large objects such as images, HTML snapshots, and backups.

optionExplanations: PB 级内容必须靠便宜的持久存储承载，只把少量热门内容放进内存缓存，才能在成本和访问速度之间取得平衡。
把 PB 级内容全部放进内存在成本上完全不现实，内存的单位价格远高于磁盘或对象存储。
DNS cache 只用来存域名到 IP 的映射，装不下也不该装 PB 级的 HTML 原文内容。
只存 URL 不存内容会让后续需要正文的解析、查询和展示都无从下手，等于放弃了内容本身。
optionExplanations_en: Petabyte-scale content has to rely on cheap persistent storage, with only a small hot slice kept in memory cache, to strike the balance between cost and access speed.
Putting all that petabyte-scale content in memory is completely unrealistic on cost — memory's per-unit price is far higher than disk or object storage.
A DNS cache only holds domain-to-IP mappings — it neither can nor should hold petabytes of raw HTML content.
Storing only the URL and not the content leaves any downstream parsing, querying, or display with nothing to work from — effectively abandoning the content itself.

scenario: parser 收到畸形 HTML，可能抛异常或解析出异常多链接。
scenario_en: The parser receives malformed HTML that may throw errors or produce an abnormal number of links.
q: parser 层要有哪些防护？
q_en: What guards should the parser have?
options: 异常捕获、大小限制、链接数量上限和数据校验
让解析异常直接抛出去，把下载线程搞崩溃
信任所有 HTML
只校验 DNS 结果
options_en: Exception handling, size limits, link-count caps, and validation.
Let parser exceptions propagate and crash downloader threads
Trust all HTML.
Validate only DNS results.
why: Web 输入不可信，parser 要把坏页面关在本组件内。限制大小和链接数也能挡部分陷阱页面。
why_en: Parser boundaries should contain malformed web input with validation and resource limits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制单个任务可消耗的 CPU、内存、大小或输出数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A resource limit caps CPU, memory, size, or output count for one task.

optionExplanations: Web 上的输入不可信，异常捕获、大小限制、链接数量上限和数据校验一起，能把一个畸形页面的破坏力关在解析这一层，不往外扩散。
把异常直接传给下载线程崩溃，会让一个坏页面拖垮本该继续拉取其他页面的下载链路。
信任所有 HTML 意味着任何畸形或恶意构造的页面都能直接冲击系统，没有任何防护。
只校验 DNS 结果针对的是域名解析阶段，跟 parser 要防的畸形 HTML 和异常链接数量完全是另一个问题。
optionExplanations_en: Input from the web can't be trusted, so exception handling, size limits, link-count caps, and data validation together contain the damage of one malformed page inside the parsing layer instead of letting it spread.
Letting an exception propagate straight into crashing the download thread lets one bad page take down the download pipeline that should keep pulling other pages.
Trusting every piece of HTML means any malformed or maliciously crafted page can hit the system directly, with no protection at all.
Validating only the DNS result targets the resolution stage, an entirely different problem from the malformed HTML and runaway link counts the parser needs to guard against.

scenario: 高 PageRank 页面持续进入 frontier；如果只抓最高优先级，低优先级页面永远没机会。
scenario_en: High-PageRank pages keep entering the frontier; if you always fetch the top priority, low-priority pages may never run.
q: queue selector 怎么避免饥饿？
q_en: How can the queue selector avoid starvation?
options: 按权重随机选择队列，并给低优先级保留小概率
永远只选最高优先级队列
完全无视优先级
把低优先级队列里的 URL 全部直接删掉
options_en: Sample queues by weight while reserving some probability for low priority.
Always choose only the highest-priority queue.
Ignore priority entirely.
Delete every URL in the low-priority queues
why: 权重选择能偏向重要页面，又不会让长尾永久饥饿。代价是高优先级页面的抓取速度略受影响。
why_en: Weighted sampling favors important pages without starving the long tail.
tradeoff: 重要性优先 vs 长尾覆盖
whenOtherWins: 如果任务是只抓 Top N 站点，严格最高优先级可能符合目标。

termDefinitions.meaning: 低优先级任务长期得不到执行机会。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Starvation means low-priority work waits indefinitely.

optionExplanations: 按权重随机选择队列，同时给低优先级留一点被选中的小概率，既能让重要页面更常被抓到，也不会让长尾页面永远轮不上。
永远只选最高优先级队列，会让低优先级页面因为新的高优先级页面不断涌入而永远排不上号，陷入饥饿。
完全无视优先级又回到了不区分页面价值的盲抓状态，放弃了打分带来的好处。
把低优先级 URL 直接删除，等于主动放弃了这批页面，而不是延后处理它们，代价过大。
optionExplanations_en: Randomly picking a queue weighted by priority, while still leaving low-priority ones a small chance of being picked, lets important pages get crawled more often without ever fully starving the long tail.
Always picking the highest-priority queue lets low-priority pages get perpetually pushed back as new high-priority pages keep arriving — outright starvation.
Ignoring priority entirely goes back to blind crawling that doesn't distinguish page value at all, throwing away the benefit of scoring in the first place.
Deleting low-priority URLs outright abandons those pages entirely instead of merely deferring them — a disproportionate cost.

scenario: 一个新闻首页每小时变化，某个老博客三年没更新；全量同频重抓太浪费。
scenario_en: A news homepage changes hourly, while an old blog has not changed for years; recrawling both equally wastes budget.
q: recrawl 间隔怎么定？
q_en: How should recrawl intervals be chosen?
options: 根据历史变化频率动态调整
所有页面每分钟重抓
所有页面永不重抓
只按 URL 字母顺序
options_en: Adjust by historical change frequency.
Recrawl every page every minute.
Never recrawl any page.
Use URL alphabetical order only.
why: 变化快的页面需要更短间隔，稳定页面可以慢一点。这个策略把 freshness 预算花在更可能变的地方。
why_en: Use historical change rate to spend freshness budget where pages are likely to change.
whenOtherWins: 如果法规要求固定归档周期，业务规则会覆盖动态间隔。

termDefinitions.meaning: 对已经抓过的 URL 再次抓取，用来刷新索引内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recrawl means fetching an already-seen URL again to refresh indexed content.

tradeoff: 页面新鲜度 vs 重抓预算
optionExplanations: 新闻首页变化快、老博客几乎不变，根据每个页面自己的历史变化频率动态调整重抓间隔，能把有限的抓取次数用在真正会变的地方。
所有页面每分钟重抓，会把预算大量浪费在那些三年都没更新过的老页面上。
所有页面永不重抓意味着新闻首页这类高频变化的内容会一直停留在旧版本，完全体现不出新鲜度。
URL 字母顺序跟页面实际会不会变化没有任何关系，用它决定重抓节奏没有意义。
optionExplanations_en: With a news homepage changing hourly and an old blog untouched for three years, adjusting each page's recrawl interval by its own historical change frequency spends the limited recrawl budget where things actually change.
Recrawling every page every minute wastes huge amounts of budget on old pages that haven't changed in three years.
Never recrawling any page means fast-changing content like a news homepage stays permanently stuck on an old version, showing no freshness at all.
A URL's alphabetical order has nothing to do with whether the page actually changes — using it to decide recrawl pace is meaningless.

scenario: 页面里有广告、隐藏 spam 链接和低价值代码片段；索引容量有限。
scenario_en: Pages contain ads, hidden spam links, and low-value code snippets; index capacity is limited.
q: 噪声内容怎么处理？
q_en: How should noisy content be handled?
options: 在解析后加内容质量/anti-spam 过滤
把抓回来的所有页面内容都当成同等的高质量
只靠 DNS cache 过滤
把广告链接优先抓取
options_en: Add content-quality or anti-spam filtering after parsing.
Treat every crawled page as equally high quality
Filter only through DNS cache.
Prioritize ad links.
why: 抓到不代表值得索引，质量过滤能保护存储和搜索结果。代价是误杀风险，需要可调规则和样本评估。
why_en: Quality filtering protects storage and search relevance, but it needs tuning to avoid false drops.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是法律取证式全量归档，过滤要更保守，可能只打标签不删除。

termDefinitions.meaning: 识别和压低垃圾或欺骗性内容的过滤机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Anti-spam mechanisms detect and reduce low-quality or deceptive content.

optionExplanations: 抓到不等于值得放进索引，解析之后加一层内容质量和反垃圾过滤，能把广告、隐藏 spam 链接这类噪声挡在有限的索引容量之外。
把广告、spam 链接和正文内容全部当成同等高质量对待，索引容量会被大量低价值内容占满，挤压真正有价值的内容。
DNS cache 只解决域名到 IP 的映射，跟判断内容本身是不是垃圾毫无关系。
把广告链接优先抓取完全跑偏了方向，广告本身正是需要被过滤掉的噪声，不该被优先对待。
optionExplanations_en: Being crawled doesn't mean being worth indexing — adding a quality and anti-spam filter after parsing keeps ads and hidden spam links from eating into limited index capacity.
Treating ads, spam links, and real content as equally high quality lets a large amount of low-value content fill up index capacity and crowd out what's actually valuable.
A DNS cache only handles domain-to-IP mapping — it has nothing to do with judging whether content itself is spam.
Prioritizing ad links to be crawled first goes in exactly the wrong direction — ads are precisely the noise that needs filtering, not preferential treatment.

scenario: 某站点导航链接由 AJAX 请求后渲染；普通 HTML downloader 只能拿到空壳页面。
scenario_en: A site renders navigation links after AJAX calls; a plain HTML downloader gets only a shell page.
q: 动态页面的抓取管线怎么改？
q_en: How should the crawl pipeline change for dynamic pages?
options: 先 headless render 再抽链
增加 URL Seen 容量即可
只改 consistent hashing
跳过 parser 直接入库
options_en: Render headlessly before link extraction.
Only increase URL Seen capacity.
Only change consistent hashing.
Skip parsing and store directly.
why: 链接生成依赖脚本执行时，必须先渲染出 DOM。渲染贵，所以要按站点或页面特征选择性启用。
why_en: When links require script execution, render the DOM first, but use this expensive path selectively.
tradeoff: 动态链接覆盖 vs 渲染成本
whenOtherWins: 静态站点不需要 headless browser，直接解析 HTML 更便宜。

termDefinitions.meaning: Asynchronous JavaScript and XML，网页异步向服务器取数据的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AJAX is a browser pattern for asynchronously fetching data from a server.

termDefinitions.meaning: Document Object Model，浏览器解析后形成的页面对象树。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The DOM is the page object tree created by the browser.

optionExplanations: 导航链接要等 AJAX 请求跑完才会出现在页面里，只有先做无头渲染、等 DOM 生成完整之后再抽链，才能拿到这些真正的链接。
增加 URL Seen 容量解决的是去重结构装不装得下的问题，跟链接压根没被渲染出来这个根源问题不相关。
改一致性哈希调整的是下载任务在机器间怎么分配，跟单个页面能不能抽出完整链接没有关系。
跳过 parser 直接把内容入库，意味着这批还没被解析、没有抽出链接的内容会直接进入下游，链接依旧缺失。
optionExplanations_en: Navigation links only appear after an AJAX request finishes, so only rendering headlessly first, waiting for a complete DOM, and then extracting links can recover these real links.
Increasing URL Seen capacity addresses whether the dedup structure can hold enough entries — unrelated to the root cause that the links were never rendered at all.
Changing consistent hashing adjusts how download tasks are distributed across machines — unrelated to whether a single page's links can be fully extracted.
Skipping the parser and loading content straight into storage means this unparsed, link-less content goes downstream as-is — the links are still missing.

scenario: link extractor 产生新 URL 的速度超过 downloader 消费速度，frontier 持续膨胀。
scenario_en: The link extractor produces new URLs faster than downloaders consume them, and the frontier keeps growing.
q: 系统需要什么背压？
q_en: What backpressure does the system need?
options: 限制入队速率或丢弃低优先级 URL
无限扩内存队列
关闭所有去重
让 parser 同步等待 DNS
options_en: Throttle enqueue rate or drop low-priority URLs.
Grow the in-memory queue without bound.
Disable all deduplication.
Make the parser synchronously wait for DNS.
why: frontier 是缓冲，不是无限垃圾桶。背压能保护内存和磁盘，通常先牺牲低价值 URL。
why_en: The frontier is a buffer, not an infinite sink, so backpressure protects storage by slowing or shedding low-value URLs.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是短暂峰值且磁盘容量充足，可以先扩大持久队列吸收。

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时，向上游减速或拒绝更多输入的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure slows or rejects upstream input when downstream cannot keep up.

optionExplanations: frontier 是有限的缓冲，不是无底洞，限制入队速率或者先丢弃低优先级 URL，能在生产速度超过消费速度时保护内存和磁盘不被撑爆。
无限扩大内存队列只是把爆炸的时间往后推迟，最终还是会在某个容量点上撑爆内存。
关闭所有去重跟“新 URL 产生得太快”这个问题没有关系，反而会让更多重复 URL 一起涌进本就吃紧的 frontier。
让 parser 同步等待 DNS 只会让处理链路整体变慢，跟“frontier 持续膨胀”这个问题的解法方向不一致。
optionExplanations_en: The frontier is a bounded buffer, not a bottomless pit — rate-limiting enqueues or dropping low-priority URLs first protects memory and disk once production outpaces consumption.
Unboundedly growing the in-memory queue only delays the eventual crash to a later, larger capacity point — it still blows up memory eventually.
Turning off all deduplication has nothing to do with new URLs being generated too fast — it would actually let even more duplicates flood into an already-strained frontier.
Making the parser wait synchronously on DNS just slows the whole pipeline down, going in a different direction from actually fixing a frontier that keeps expanding.

scenario: URL Seen 的内存结构重启后丢失；系统恢复时可能把大量已抓 URL 重新入队。
scenario_en: The in-memory URL Seen structure is lost on restart; recovery may enqueue many already-crawled URLs again.
q: URL Seen 为什么还要持久层？
q_en: Why does URL Seen need a persistent layer?
options: 恢复已访问状态，避免重启后重复抓取
让 Bloom filter 没有误判
替代 HTML storage
提升 DNS 权威性
options_en: Recover visited state and avoid duplicate crawling after restart.
Make Bloom filters have no false positives.
Replace HTML storage.
Improve DNS authority.
why: 内存过滤器服务热路径，持久 URL store 服务恢复和审计。两层职责不同，不能只靠内存。
why_en: The in-memory filter serves the hot path, while persistent URL storage supports recovery and auditing.
whenOtherWins: 极小临时爬虫可以接受重启后从头来，持久层可省。

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程重启或机器故障后仍保留数据的存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A persistent store keeps data after process restarts or machine failures.

tradeoff: 热路径速度 vs 重启恢复能力
optionExplanations: 内存过滤器重启就会丢失，靠持久层保存已访问状态，重启后系统才能知道哪些 URL 已经抓过，不会把它们全部重新塞进队列。
持久层解决的是重启后状态能不能恢复，跟内存里 Bloom filter 本身还会不会误判是两个不同的问题。
持久 URL store 记录的是“这个 URL 有没有被处理过”这类状态，不是用来存 HTML 正文的，替代不了内容存储。
持久层跟 DNS 权威性完全不是一回事，它管的是爬虫自己的访问状态，不涉及域名解析的权威来源。
optionExplanations_en: An in-memory filter loses its state on restart, so a persistent layer recording visited status is what lets the system know after a restart which URLs were already crawled instead of shoving them all back into the queue.
A persistent layer addresses whether state can be recovered after a restart — a different question from whether the in-memory Bloom filter itself still produces false positives.
A persistent URL store records state like "has this URL been processed," not the HTML body itself — it can't substitute for content storage.
A persistent layer has nothing to do with DNS authority — it manages the crawler's own visited state, not the authoritative source of domain resolution.

scenario: 爬虫上线后要调优 freshness、礼貌性和失败恢复，而不是只看抓了多少页。
scenario_en: After launch, a crawler must tune freshness, politeness, and recovery, not only count fetched pages.
q: 哪些指标最该监控？
q_en: Which metrics matter most?
options: 核心 crawler 健康指标
只统计员工人数和办公室的室内温度
模板点击率
聊天未读数
options_en: Core crawler health metrics.
Headcount and office temperature
Template click rate.
Chat unread count.
why: 这些指标分别对应站点压力、积压、稳定性、浪费和索引质量。只有下载总数会掩盖系统是否健康。
why_en: These metrics map to site pressure, backlog, reliability, wasted work, and index quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: frontier 中等待处理的 URL 数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Frontier depth is the number of URLs waiting in the frontier.

optionExplanations: 对，站点压力、队列积压、系统稳定性和索引质量这些核心健康指标，才能真正告诉你爬虫是不是在正常运转。
员工人数和办公室温度跟爬虫系统运行状态毫无关系，不是该被监控的技术指标。
模板点击率是产品层面的用户行为指标，不反映爬虫本身的健康状况。
聊天未读数完全是另一个产品的指标，跟爬虫的抓取质量、稳定性没有任何关系。
optionExplanations_en: Right — core health metrics like site load, queue backlog, system stability, and index quality are what actually tell you whether the crawler is running well.
Headcount and office temperature have nothing to do with the crawler system's operating state — not technical metrics worth monitoring here.
Template click-through rate is a product-level user-behavior metric, unrelated to the crawler's own health.
Unread chat count belongs to an entirely different product, with no bearing on the crawler's crawl quality or stability.

scenario: 你要把新发现 URL 放进一个既讲优先级又讲礼貌性的 frontier。
scenario_en: You need to put newly discovered URLs into a frontier that handles both priority and politeness.
q: frontier 入队到出队的关键顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the key frontier path from enqueue to dequeue?
steps: queue selector 按权重选择 front queue
URL 规范化、过滤和 URL Seen 去重
queue router 按 host 放入 back queue
prioritizer 计算 URL 分数
worker 从 host back queue 按限速下载
why: 先清洗和去重，再决定价值；出队时还要按 host 控制节奏。这样 priority 和 politeness 不互相替代。
why_en: Clean and dedupe first, score priority next, then route by host so priority and politeness both hold.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Normalize and dedupe] --> B[Prioritizer]
  B --> C[Front queues]
  C --> D[Host router]
  D --> E[Back queues]
  E --> F[Rate-limited workers]

scenario: 平均页面 500 KB，每月新增 10 亿页面；你要给存储团队一个月增量量级。
scenario_en: Average page size is 500 KB and the crawler adds 1 billion pages per month; you need a monthly storage order of magnitude.
q: 月增量存储怎么算？
q_en: How do you calculate monthly storage growth?
text: 月增量约 {{1B * 500 KB = 500 TB}}；这个数决定对象存储、分片数和压缩策略。
text_en: Monthly growth is about {{1B * 500 KB = 500 TB}}; it drives object storage, shard count, and compression strategy.
why: 这是设计输入，不是要背数字。它告诉你内存缓存只能放热点，长期原文必须进入便宜持久存储。
why_en: The number is a design input: hot pages may be cached, but long-term raw content needs cheap durable storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: Terabyte，约 1000 GB 的存储单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A terabyte is a storage unit of about one thousand gigabytes.

scenario: 系统每天发送 1000 万 push、100 万 SMS、500 万 email，允许高峰时轻微延迟。
scenario_en: The system sends 10M push, 1M SMS, and 5M emails per day, with slight delay allowed under peak load.
q: 这个吞吐对架构意味着什么？
q_en: What does this throughput imply for architecture?
text: 总量约 {{16M/day}}，平均约 {{185 notifications/s}}；它是 worker 数、队列容量和第三方限流配置的基数。
text_en: The total is about {{16M/day}}, around {{185 notifications/s}} on average; it feeds worker count, queue capacity, and provider rate limits.
why: 平均值不高，但通知有活动尖峰，所以不能用同步单机硬发。队列吸收突发，worker 按通道水平扩容。
why_en: The average rate is modest, but campaign bursts require queues and horizontally scaled workers rather than synchronous sending.

termDefinitions.meaning: Short Message Service，手机短信通道。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMS means Short Message Service, the phone text-message channel.

scenario: 一个通知系统同时发 push、SMS 和 email；某个 SMS 供应商宕机时，不希望 push 和 email 也堵住。
scenario_en: A notification system sends push, SMS, and email; if the SMS provider is down, push and email should keep flowing.
q: 队列怎么拆？
q_en: How should the queues be split?
options: 每种通知类型独立队列和 worker
所有通知共用一个 FIFO 队列
绕过队列同步调用供应商
按用户姓名首字母分队列
options_en: Use a separate queue and worker pool per notification type.
Use one FIFO queue for all notifications.
Synchronously call providers without queues.
Partition queues by the first letter of user names.
why: 通道隔离能把 SMS 故障限制在 SMS 队列里。代价是每个通道都要单独监控积压和重试。
why_en: Separate queues isolate one provider's outage from other channels, while requiring per-channel monitoring and retry policy.
tradeoff: 故障隔离 vs 运维组件数
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一种通知且量很小，单队列更简单。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  API[Notification API] --> PushQ[Push queue]
  API --> SMSQ[SMS queue]
  API --> EmailQ[Email queue]
  PushQ --> PW[Push workers]
  SMSQ --> SW[SMS workers]
  EmailQ --> EW[Email workers]

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行发送动作的后台进程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background process that pulls jobs from a queue and performs delivery.

optionExplanations: 给 push、SMS、email 各配一条独立队列和 worker，SMS 供应商挂了，积压只会堆在 SMS 自己的队列里，不会连带堵住另外两条通道。
所有通知共用一个 FIFO，SMS 处理不动时，排在它后面的 push 和 email 也会被一起卡住，起不到隔离作用。
绕过队列同步调用供应商，一旦某个供应商响应慢，会直接拖慢发起请求的业务线程，风险更集中。
按用户姓名首字母分队列跟“哪个通道故障”完全不是一回事，同一个 SMS 供应商故障还是会分散影响到所有字母分区。
optionExplanations_en: Giving push, SMS, and email each their own queue and workers means an SMS provider outage only piles up in the SMS queue, without dragging the other two channels down with it.
Sharing one FIFO across all types means SMS getting stuck also blocks whatever push and email notifications are queued behind it — no isolation at all.
Bypassing the queue to call the provider synchronously means one slow provider directly stalls the business thread that made the call, concentrating the risk instead of containing it.
Splitting queues by the first letter of a user's name has nothing to do with which channel is failing — an SMS provider outage would still spread across every letter partition.

scenario: 业务允许通知晚到，但不允许支付提醒这类通知在系统故障后直接丢失。
scenario_en: The business allows notification delay, but payment reminders must not disappear after system failures.
q: 防丢失先加什么？
q_en: What should be added first to prevent loss?
options: 通知日志持久化，再由队列/worker 重试
只把通知事件放进单机进程内的内存队列里排队
失败后让客户端自己猜
关闭第三方回调
options_en: Persist a notification log, then retry through queues and workers.
Keep notification events only in a single-process in-memory queue
Let clients guess after failure.
Disable provider callbacks.
why: 可靠性的底线是先把要发什么落库，worker 失败后还能重建任务。代价是要处理重复发送和日志清理。
why_en: Persist the notification intent before delivery so failed workers can retry without losing the message.
whenOtherWins: 如果是低价值营销实验，允许丢弃时可以用更轻的 best-effort 管线。

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存待发送或已发送通知事件的持久记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A notification log is a durable record of notification events to send or already sent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 尽力而为语义，系统尝试发送但不保证成功。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Best-effort means the system tries but does not guarantee delivery.

optionExplanations: 先把要发的事件持久化落库，再让队列和 worker 去消费，即使 worker 挂了，这条记录还在，之后还能重新拾起来发送。
只放内存队列，进程一崩溃，还没来得及发出去的事件就彻底没了，跟支付提醒不能丢的要求直接冲突。
失败后让客户端自己猜完全没有依据，客户端根本不知道服务端到底有没有真正处理这个事件。
关闭第三方回调只是少了一路状态反馈，事件本身该不该发、发没发出去的问题完全没解决。
optionExplanations_en: Persisting the event to durable storage first, then letting the queue and workers consume it, means even if a worker dies, the record is still there and can be picked back up and sent later.
Keeping it only in an in-memory queue means a process crash loses any event that hadn't gone out yet, directly conflicting with the requirement that payment reminders can't be lost.
Having the client guess after a failure has nothing to go on — the client has no way to know whether the server actually processed the event at all.
Turning off the third-party callback just removes one channel of status feedback — it does nothing to solve whether the event should have been sent or actually was.

scenario: worker 超时后重试，第三方也可能返回不确定结果；同一个事件可能被处理两次。
scenario_en: A worker retries after timeout, and provider results may be ambiguous; the same event may be processed twice.
q: 怎么降低重复通知？
q_en: How do you reduce duplicate notifications?
options: 用 event_id 做幂等去重，见过就丢弃
直接向调用方承诺分布式 exactly once
把重试次数设为无限
改用更长模板文案
options_en: Use event_id for idempotent dedupe and discard seen events.
Promise distributed exactly-once delivery
Retry forever.
Use longer template copy.
why: 分布式发送很难保证真正 exactly once，所以要用事件 ID 把重试变成幂等。代价是去重窗口和存储也要设计。
why_en: In distributed delivery, use an event ID for idempotency instead of promising true exactly-once semantics.
tradeoff: 不丢失重试 vs 重复抑制
whenOtherWins: 如果供应商提供强幂等 key，也应把本地 event_id 映射到供应商 key。

termDefinitions.meaning: 通知事件的唯一标识，用来判断同一事件是否已处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An event_id uniquely identifies a notification event for deduplication.

termDefinitions.meaning: 幂等表示同一操作重复执行，最终效果仍像执行一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means repeating the same operation has the same final effect as doing it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 精确一次语义，表示既不丢也不重复；跨系统发送通常很难严格保证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exactly once means no loss and no duplicates, which is very hard across distributed systems.

optionExplanations: 用事件本身自带的 ID 做幂等判断，见过就直接丢弃，重试多少次结果都只会真正发出去一次。
分布式系统里网络和第三方状态都不确定，承诺真正的 exactly once 在工程上很难兑现，容易变成一句空话。
把重试次数设为无限只会让一次持续失败的请求永远占着资源，跟降低重复完全不是一回事。
改用更长模板文案是内容层面的事，跟同一个事件被重复处理两次这个根因毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: Using the event's own ID for an idempotency check and discarding anything already seen means no matter how many times it retries, it only actually goes out once.
In a distributed system, network and third-party states are inherently uncertain, so promising true exactly-once delivery is extremely hard to actually deliver on in practice.
Setting retries to unlimited just lets one persistently failing request hog resources forever — that's unrelated to reducing duplicates.
Switching to longer template copy is a content-layer concern, unrelated to the root cause of the same event being processed twice.

scenario: 用户可以按 push/email/SMS 选择退订；系统准备发送前已拿到用户 ID 和通道。
scenario_en: Users can opt out per push, email, or SMS channel; the system has the user ID and channel before sending.
q: 设置检查放在哪里？
q_en: Where should the settings check happen?
options: 发送前查 settings
只在客户端下载消息时才顺便做检查
交给第三方服务决定
发送失败后再检查
options_en: Check settings before sending.
Check only in the client at download time
Let the third-party provider decide.
Check only after delivery fails.
why: 退订是发送前约束，越早过滤越少浪费队列和供应商额度。代价是设置缓存要避免过期太久。
why_en: Opt-out is a pre-send constraint, so checking it early saves queue capacity and provider quota.
whenOtherWins: 如果设置要求强实时生效，就要缩短缓存 TTL 或在发送前读主库。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户明确选择不接收某类通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Opt-out means the user has chosen not to receive a notification type.

termDefinitions.meaning: Time To Live，缓存条目可被复用的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the lifetime of a cached entry.

tradeoff: 发送前过滤 vs 每次读取设置的成本
optionExplanations: 发送前先查一次用户在这个通道上的退订设置，能在真正占用队列和供应商额度之前就把不该发的挡下来。
只在客户端下载时检查完全没用，发送这个动作发生在服务端，客户端本地检查挡不住服务端的真实发送。
把这个判断交给第三方服务，等于把本该属于自己业务逻辑的退订规则外包出去，供应商未必知道你的退订语义。
等发送失败后再检查，通知已经被发出去了，用户已经收到了本不该收到的消息，为时已晚。
optionExplanations_en: Checking the user's opt-out setting for this channel right before sending catches it before queue slots and provider quota get wasted on something that shouldn't go out.
Checking only on the client's download does nothing — the actual send happens server-side, and a local client check can't stop the server from really sending it.
Handing this decision off to a third-party service outsources what should be your own business logic — the provider has no idea what your opt-out semantics even mean.
Checking only after a send failure means the notification already went out and the user already received something they shouldn't have — too late.

scenario: 每天有大量相似通知，只是商品名、日期、链接和样式参数不同。
scenario_en: Millions of notifications share the same shape, with only item name, date, link, and style parameters changing.
q: 为什么要引入模板？
q_en: Why introduce templates?
options: 复用格式并减少人工拼接错误
让所有通知绕过设置检查
替代消息队列
保证第三方永不失败
options_en: Reuse format and reduce manual composition errors.
Bypass all settings checks.
Replace message queues.
Guarantee providers never fail.
why: 模板把稳定文案和变量分开，批量发送时更容易保持一致。代价是模板版本、审核和回滚要纳入流程。
why_en: Templates separate stable copy from variables, making high-volume notification creation more consistent.
whenOtherWins: 如果通知完全一次性且量很小，直接拼一条消息更快。

termDefinitions.meaning: 预先定义的通知骨架，发送时填入变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A template is a predefined notification body filled with variables at send time.

tradeoff: 模板复用和审核 vs 模板管理成本
optionExplanations: 把固定不变的文案格式和会变的商品名、日期、链接这些变量分开，批量发送时复用同一个格式，就不用每次手工拼接容易出错的字符串。
模板管理的是内容格式，跟要不要检查用户退订设置是两件完全不同的事，模板不会让检查被绕过。
模板负责的是内容生成，跟负责传输和调度的消息队列职责完全不同，替代不了队列。
模板本身跟第三方服务会不会失败没有任何关系，供应商照样可能因为各种原因返回错误。
optionExplanations_en: Separating the fixed wording from variables like product name, date, link, and style lets a batch of similar sends reuse the same format instead of hand-assembling error-prone strings every time.
Template management is about content format, an entirely different concern from checking user opt-out settings — templates don't bypass that check.
A template's job is generating content, a different responsibility from the message queue's job of transport and scheduling — it can't substitute for it.
A template has nothing to do with whether a third-party service fails — the provider can still return errors for all sorts of reasons regardless.

scenario: 营销服务可能连续触发很多消息；用户收到太多会关闭整个 App 的通知权限。
scenario_en: A marketing service may trigger many messages in a row; too many notifications may make users disable the app entirely.
q: 该加什么保护？
q_en: What protection should be added?
options: 按用户和通道做 frequency cap
不断提高 worker 数量硬着头皮往外发
把所有消息改成 push
只监控 CPU
options_en: Add a per-user and per-channel frequency cap.
Keep raising worker count and push harder
Convert every message to push.
Monitor only CPU.
why: 这里的瓶颈不是 worker，而是用户注意力和退订风险。限频会牺牲部分触达，但保护长期可用性。
why_en: Rate limiting protects user attention and long-term opt-in, even though some sends will be delayed or dropped.
tradeoff: 触达量 vs 用户疲劳
whenOtherWins: 如果是安全验证码或交易提醒，限频规则要更宽或走高优先级通道。

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制某用户在某时间窗口内最多收到多少通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A frequency cap limits how many notifications a user can receive in a time window.

optionExplanations: 瓶颈不在 worker 处理能力，而在用户能承受多少通知，按用户和通道设置一个发送频次上限，能在触达和不激怒用户之间找到平衡。
无限提高 worker 数只会让更多消息更快地涌向用户，进一步加剧用户被打扰的问题，跟真正的瓶颈方向不对。
把所有消息都改成 push 只是换了个通道继续轰炸用户，没有解决“发得太多”这个根本问题。
只监控 CPU 看到的是机器资源，反映不出用户正在被过度打扰、马上要关闭通知权限这个真正的风险。
optionExplanations_en: The bottleneck here isn't worker capacity but how much a user can tolerate, so capping send frequency per user per channel balances reach against not driving users away.
Scaling up workers without limit just pushes even more messages at users even faster, making the actual problem of over-notifying worse, not better.
Switching every message to push just moves the flood to a different channel — it doesn't address the underlying problem of sending too much.
Watching only CPU shows machine resource usage, not the real risk that users are being overwhelmed and about to shut off notifications entirely.

scenario: 产品要进入一个 APNS/FCM 或某短信供应商不可用的新市场，还要快速切换替代供应商。
scenario_en: The product enters a market where APNS/FCM or an SMS provider may be unavailable, and provider switching must be quick.
q: 第三方集成怎么设计？
q_en: How should third-party integration be designed?
options: 按通道抽象 provider adapter，可插拔替换
业务代码里到处直接调用供应商 SDK
只支持一个全球供应商
干脆让客户端直接拿着 appSecret 去调供应商接口
options_en: Use pluggable provider adapters per channel.
Call provider SDKs directly throughout business code.
Support only one global provider.
Just let clients call the provider API directly with the appSecret
why: 供应商可用性会随地区变化，adapter 能把切换限制在通道实现里。代价是要抽象最小公共能力和错误码。
why_en: Provider adapters localize market-specific provider changes behind a channel interface.
tradeoff: 可替换性 vs 抽象成本
whenOtherWins: 如果只服务单一地区且供应商长期稳定，直接集成可先上线。

termDefinitions.meaning: Apple Push Notification Service，Apple 的 iOS 推送服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: APNS is Apple's push notification service for iOS devices.

termDefinitions.meaning: Firebase Cloud Messaging，常用于 Android 推送。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FCM is Firebase Cloud Messaging, commonly used for Android push.

termDefinitions.meaning: Software Development Kit，供应商提供的开发工具包。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SDK is a vendor-provided Software Development Kit.

optionExplanations: 按通道抽象出一层可插拔的 provider adapter，切换供应商时只需要换掉这一层实现，不用改动上层业务逻辑。
业务代码里到处直接调用某个供应商的 SDK，一旦要换供应商，就要满代码库地找、改所有调用点，风险和工作量都很大。
只支持一个全球供应商完全没法应对某个地区这个供应商不可用、需要快速切换的场景。
让客户端直接拿着 appSecret 调用供应商，等于把敏感凭证暴露给客户端，安全风险很大。
optionExplanations_en: Abstracting a pluggable provider adapter per channel means switching providers only requires swapping out that one implementation, without touching the business logic above it.
Calling a specific provider's SDK directly scattered throughout the business code means switching providers later requires hunting down and changing every single call site — risky and slow.
Supporting only one global provider offers no way to handle a region where that provider is down and a fast switch to an alternative is needed.
Letting the client hold the appSecret and call the provider directly exposes a sensitive credential straight to the client — a serious security risk.

scenario: 同一个用户可能有手机、平板和桌面端；push 需要定位到具体设备。
scenario_en: One user may have a phone, tablet, and desktop; push delivery must target concrete devices.
q: device token 存在哪里更合理？
q_en: Where should device tokens be stored?
options: device 表存 token
只放 user 表一个字段
只存在客户端内存
写进通知模板
options_en: Store tokens in the device table.
As one field on the user table only.
Only in client memory.
Inside the notification template.
why: push token 是设备级标识，一个用户多设备时要一对多建模。email 和 phone 更像用户联系信息，可放用户资料或联系表。
why_en: Push tokens are device-level identifiers, so model them as many devices per user.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确只允许单设备登录，user 表上的当前 token 可以作为简化版本。

termDefinitions.meaning: 推送平台分配给某个设备/应用安装的发送标识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A device token is the push-platform identifier for a device or app installation.

optionExplanations: push 要精确送到某一台具体设备上，一个用户可能同时有手机、平板和桌面端，用一张一对多的设备表存 token 才能表达这种关系。
用户表上只放一个字段，一个用户有多台设备时，新设备的 token 会不断覆盖旧的，其他设备就再也收不到 push 了。
只存在客户端内存，服务端根本拿不到这个 token，也就没法在服务端发起 push 请求了。
模板存的是通知文案格式，跟某个用户具体设备的 token 是完全不同性质的两种数据。
optionExplanations_en: A push needs to land on one specific device, and a single user can have a phone, tablet, and desktop at once, so a one-to-many device table is what actually models that relationship.
Putting it in a single field on the user table means a new device's token keeps overwriting the old one whenever there are multiple devices, and the other devices simply stop getting push at all.
Keeping it only in client memory means the server never has the token in the first place and has no way to originate a push request from there.
A template stores the wording format of a notification, an entirely different kind of data from a specific device's token.

scenario: push 队列积压持续增长，第三方没有报错，但用户收到通知越来越晚。
scenario_en: The push queue backlog keeps growing, providers report no errors, and users receive notifications later and later.
q: 该先看哪个指标并采取什么动作？
q_en: Which metric and action should come first?
options: 看队列深度并扩 worker
模板字符数；改短文案
用户头像缓存命中率；清缓存
数据库表名长度；重命名
options_en: Watch queue depth and scale workers.
Template character count; shorten copy.
Avatar cache hit rate; clear cache.
Database table-name length; rename tables.
